seasons.description: Koyori attends Suzumegahara, igniting a fierce ping pong rivalry among friends aiming for the national title.

seasons.title: Crossing Time
seasons.description: “Clank, clank, clank, clank...” Today, the railroad crossing bar goes down again, stopping someone on their way somewhere. The various stories of youth, eros, art, first love, etc that occur during the time spent waiting at a railroad crossing... All railroad crossings, all the time. Bringing you a variety of short stories about railroad crossings!

seasons.title: GIBIATE
seasons.description: Samurai and ninja from the past join forces with a doctor to cure a monster-making virus in a desolate Japan.

seasons.title: The 2019 Crunchyroll Anime Awards
seasons.description: Celebrate the best of anime as fans and judges crown the top series, characters, and more.

seasons.title: The 2021 Crunchyroll Anime Awards
seasons.description: The 2021 Crunchyroll Anime Awards

seasons.title: The 2023 Crunchyroll Anime Awards
seasons.description: The 2023 Crunchyroll Anime Awards

seasons.title: The 2024 Crunchyroll Anime Awards
seasons.description: Crunchyroll presents the 8th annual Anime Awards on March 2, 2024, live from Tokyo, hosted by Sally Amaki and Jon Kabira. Watch the livestream to see 25+ categories awarded to the industry’s top talent, creators and performers. The Anime Awards includes celebrity presenters, musical performances and, of course, all the awards delivered in person!

seasons.title: The 2025 Crunchyroll Anime Awards
seasons.description: Relive the 9th Annual Crunchyroll Anime Awards, premiered from Tokyo on May 25, 2025. Hosted by Sally Amaki and Jon Kabira, this unforgettable evening celebrated the boundless creativity, artistry, and cultural impact of one of the world’s most cherished forms of storytelling—anime. See the industry's finest creators, performers, and visionaries as we presented over 30 prestigious awards.

seasons.title: The 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards
seasons.description: Experience the 10th Annual Crunchyroll Anime Awards, recorded live in Tokyo. Hosted by Sally Amaki and Jon Kabira, this milestone event celebrates a decade of honoring anime’s artistry and cultural influence while highlighting the stories and creators shaping its future. Featuring 30+ awards, appearances by celebrity and industry presenters, and live performances.

seasons.title: Muhyo & Roji's Bureau of Supernatural Investigation
seasons.description: Are you a victim of unwanted spirit possession? Is there a ghost you need sent up and away... or down to burn for all eternity? If the answer is "yes," then you need Muhyo and Roji, the experts in supernatural law. Serving justice to evil spirits is their specialty.

seasons.title: Muhyo & Roji's Bureau of Supernatural Investigation Season 2
seasons.description: Are you a victim of unwanted spirit possession? Is there a ghost you need sent up and away... or down to burn for all eternity? If the answer is "yes," then you need Muhyo and Roji, the experts in supernatural law. Serving justice to evil spirits is their specialty.

seasons.title: Cells at Work!
seasons.description: This is a story about you. It’s a tale about the inside of your body. According to a new study, the human body consists of approximately 37 trillion cells. These cells are hard at work every day within your body’s world. From the oxygen-carrying Red Blood cells to the bacteria-fighting White Blood cells, they’re the unsung heroes of your body. Get to know the drama that’s unfolding inside of you!

seasons.title: Cells at Work!!
seasons.description: This is a tale about the inside of your body. Get to know the oxygen-carrying Red Blood cells and bacteria-fighting White Blood cells.

seasons.title: Danganronpa 3: Season 1: Future Arc
seasons.description: Taking place before season one of the Danganronpa anime and after the hit game, Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, comes two new arcs!

seasons.title: Danganronpa 3: Season 2: Despair Arc
seasons.description: Taking place before season one of the Danganronpa anime and after the hit game, Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, comes two new arcs!

seasons.title: Sengoku Collection (Parallel World Samurai)
seasons.description: In a parallel world, Oda Nobunaga and a number of others are sucked into our world. Stranded in a strange land, Nobunaga and the others are forced to adapt to survive. Tokugawa Ieyasu is now a cute pop idol? Uesugi Kenshin is a voluptuous model?! Unlike the others, Nobunaga is determined to escape from our world, so she sets out to collect the "Secret Treasures" - her only key to returning home.

seasons.title: Magimoji Rurumo
seasons.description: Kota gains magical tickets to aid Rurumo's training, but each wish shortens his life. Will he risk it all?

seasons.title: Restaurant to Another World
seasons.description: Welcome to Nekoya—a quaint little eatery that specializes in western-style cuisine. Every seven days, people and creatures, from different corners of another world, flock to the restaurant to munch on their favorite dishes. And despite the wide range of patrons, there’s always something delicious available—even for those with the most particular preferences and palates.

seasons.title: Restaurant to Another World
seasons.description: Step into a restaurant where the regulars are anything but normal! Faithfully serving Western cuisine for years, when Saturday rolls around and a special bell rings, this popular spot opens its doors to much more unusual guests.

seasons.title: 18if
seasons.description: After falling to sleep one night, Haruto Tsukishiro finds himself trapped in a dream realm, unable to wake up. He meets a professor, Katsumi Kanzaki, and a young white-haired girl, Lily, who agree to help him on his quest to escape. Together, they must outsmart powerful witches—trapped souls who rejected reality and now rule the dream realm. Time is running out for Haruto to find his way home!

seasons.title: Sword Art Online
seasons.description: In a virtual world, players must beat the game to escape—or face real-life death.

seasons.title: Sword Art Online II
seasons.description: In a virtual world, players must beat the game to escape—or face real-life death.

seasons.title: Sword Art Online Alicization
seasons.description: In a virtual world, players must beat the game to escape—or face real-life death.

seasons.title: Sword Art Online Alicization War of Underworld
seasons.description: In a virtual world, players must beat the game to escape—or face real-life death.

seasons.title: Pan de Peace!
seasons.description: Based on a 4-panel manga by Emily, Pan de Peace! focuses on the bread-loving girl Minami, who is starting high school and loves to eat bread for breakfast, along with her friends Yuu, Fuyumi, and Noa.

seasons.title: Recovery of an MMO Junkie
seasons.description: 30-year-old Moriko Morioka has given up on reality! Forget dating and responsibilities—she’s escaping to the world of online gaming. Here, she starts a new life as the handsome character Hayashi who, while learning the game, receives help from a beauty named Lily. The longer she plays, the more attached she grows, and soon her online connection will lead to an exciting IRL encounter!

seasons.title: Hakata Mentai! Pirikarako-chan
seasons.description: Hakata Mentai! Pirikarako-chan is set in a mysterious shopping center in a town that is like but also not quite like Hakata. In this setting, a walleye pollack roe fairy named Pirikarakochan rushes about every day trying to ease the worries and solve the rumors of the other food fairies.

seasons.title: MEGALOBOX 2: NOMAD
seasons.description: Junk Dog, a nameless fighter, rigs MEGALOBOX matches. Meeting champion Yuri sparks a fierce rivalry.

seasons.title: The Helpful Fox Senko-san
seasons.description: Sometimes the cure to a hard day’s work is the tender love and care of...a fox girl?! Salaryman Nakano’s stressful life is suddenly intruded upon by the fox, Senko-san, who is eager to help him heal his exhaustion. Whether she’s cooking, cleaning, or finding other ways to care for Nakano, she’s there to take away his stress!

seasons.title: Nyanpire - The Vampire Cat
seasons.description: A kitten, abandoned and starving, is transformed into a tiny vampire by a mysterious stranger.

seasons.title: Jingai-san no Yome
seasons.description: Hinowa, an ordinary teen, suddenly weds a mysterious creature, starting a sweet, unexpected life together.

seasons.title: Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka
seasons.description: Beings from another reality invaded the Earth with an army of monstrosities. They were barely defeated by a squad of elite magical girl soldiers, the Magical Five, after an entire year of bloodshed. Now, three years later, Asuka wants nothing more than to escape the horrors of her past. But she and her karambit are thrust back into the thick of it when her friends and home come under attack.

seasons.title: GAMERS!
seasons.description: Keita Amano has always preferred the company of games over people, leading a rather lonely life. But at school he finds himself in the gaming club where every day is more interesting than the games they play! With beautiful club president Karen Tendou, testy Chiaki Hoshinomori, and the guy who claims to have it all together, Uehara Tasuku, things are sure to get a little chaotic!

seasons.title: Working Buddies!
seasons.description: Calico Tapio Chatorazawa, who's got more energy than anyone, Russian Blue Kuehiko Roshihara's a bit of a sourpuss. These two classmates will do all kinds of different jobs to learn how fun and hard it is to work!

seasons.title: Working Buddies! 2
seasons.description: Calico Tapio Chatorazawa, who's got more energy than anyone, Russian Blue Kuehiko Roshihara's a bit of a sourpuss. These two classmates will do all kinds of different jobs to learn how fun and hard it is to work!

seasons.title: Kokoro Connect
seasons.description: Five friends swap personalities, exposing secrets and altering their bonds.

seasons.title: Bungo Stray Dogs
seasons.description: Framed as criminals and hounded by the brutal Hunting Dogs, the Armed Detective Agency turns to old enemies for relief. But when their investigation uncovers the Decay of Angels’ disturbing plans for the planet, Dazai, Nakajima, and the gang must shift their attention to unearthing the terrorist Kamui—all while avoiding the deadly Army of Mankind.

seasons.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Season 2
seasons.description: A darker chapter of Dazai’s past reveals his ties to the Port Mafia. Now, four years later, a gifted group of Americans known as the Guild have challenged the mafia’s power. Atsushi has his work cut out for him while Akutagawa grows more resentful by the day. But when the Guild becomes a threat to all of Yokohama, a united front between bitter enemies may be the only way to save the city.

seasons.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Season 3
seasons.description: Another chapter of Dazai’s past tells how he first partnered with Chuuya, whose own history weaves a shocking truth. Now, the powers controlling Yokohama have formed an alliance, but their unity is jeopardized by the man who sank the Moby Dick! What new duo will step forward to take down this formidable foe?

seasons.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Season 4
seasons.description: After a flashback to Rampo and Fukuzawa’s first case, the agency finds itself at the whim of a reality-altering book. Its wielders, a group known as the Decay of Angels, have framed the agency for murder. Could this spell the end of the Armed Detective Agency?

seasons.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Season 5
seasons.description: Framed as criminals and hounded by the brutal Hunting Dogs, the Armed Detective Agency turns to old enemies for relief. But when their investigation uncovers the Decay of Angels’ disturbing plans for the planet, Dazai, Nakajima, and the gang must shift their attention to unearthing the terrorist Kamui—all while avoiding the deadly Army of Mankind. They have six days to rewrite the world’s fate!

seasons.title: Attack on Titan
seasons.description: When a Colossal Titan attacks, humanity’s future crumbles along with its defensive walls. As survivors of the bloodshed, Eren Jaeger and his friends enlist to fight the enemy. With a vow to “KILL EVERY TITAN,” the key to survival lies within Eren.

seasons.title: Attack on Titan Season 3
seasons.description: The war for Paradis zeroes in on Shiganshina just as Jaegerists have seized control. After taking a huge blow from a surprise attack led by Eren, Marley swiftly acts to return the favor. With Zeke’s true plan revealed and a military forced under new rule, this battle might be fought on two fronts. Does Eren intend on fulfilling his half-brother’s wishes or does he have a plan of his own?

seasons.title: Attack on Titan Final Season
seasons.description: The Scout Regiment have just discovered the existence of Marley, the nation determined to eradicate their people. Now with the dark history of the Titans uncovered, they plan to set out for the world beyond their walls. Will Paradis finally know freedom?

seasons.title: Attack on Titan: Last Attack
seasons.description: Eren’s apocalyptic rumbling begins, unleashing an unstoppable wave of Colossal Titans marching to crush the world. Having uncovered Paradis’s brutal history and the world’s hatred for Eldians, he commits to eliminating all threats. Now former allies and enemies unite in desperation for one final mission—to stop him before nothing remains.

seasons.title: Attack on Titan OADs
seasons.description: Humanity's safety behind walls shatters, forcing them to fight or be devoured by Titans.

seasons.title: PSYCHO-PASS
seasons.description: Welcome to a world where just thinking about a crime is enough to make you guilty. Bad intentions can no longer be hidden, and the all-powerful Sibyl System keeps a watchful eye on us all. However, consistent success doesn’t assure infallibility when a deranged genius known as Makishima masters the art of justifying his own heinous deeds.

seasons.title: PSYCHO-PASS Extended Edition
seasons.description: In the future, thinking about a crime makes you guilty, and justice is dispensed from the barrel of a gun. Detectives work in teams made up of Enforcers and Inspectors. Enforcers take out the bad guys, and Inspectors make sure their partners don’t cross the line. The equalizer in the war on thugs is the Dominator, a weapon that can tell when citizens are about to turn criminal.

seasons.title: PSYCHO-PASS 2
seasons.description: It’s been a little over a year since Inspector Akane Tsunemori chose to put her faith in the Sibyl System and keep its true nature a secret. Just as she settles into her new routine, a bombing in the center of the city launches an investigation that uncovers a network of latent criminals who claim their leader has the power to lower their crime coefficients.

seasons.title: PSYCHO-PASS: Sinners of the System
seasons.description: A trilogy of stories based on the characters who appear in PSYCHO-PASS.

seasons.title: PSYCHO-PASS 3
seasons.description: In the future, thinking about a crime makes you guilty, and justice is dispensed from the barrel of a gun. Detectives work in teams made up of Enforcers and Inspectors. Enforcers take out the bad guys, and Inspectors make sure their partners don’t cross the line. The equalizer in the war on thugs is the Dominator, a weapon that can tell when citizens are about to turn criminal.

seasons.title: PSYCHO-PASS 3: First Inspector
seasons.description: When Arata and Kei, the two inspectors who lead CID Unit One, clash over truth and justice during an investigation, the mastermind behind the case, Koichi Azusawa, launches an assault on the Public Safety Bureau Building, putting the detectives in a predicament like never seen before.

seasons.title: Heat Guy J
seasons.description: The city of Judoh ain’t such a nice place to live. Deranged Mafioso Claire Leonelli rules the streets with an unpredictable brutality, and the police can’t do a damn thing to stop him. Their only hope is to find a hero—or two. Enter special agent Daisuke Aurora and a steam-powered punisher of punks known as Android J.

seasons.title: World Trigger
seasons.description: Alien invaders threaten Mikado City, but the Border Defense Agency fights back with advanced tech.

seasons.title: World Trigger 2nd Season
seasons.description: Alien invaders threaten Mikado City, but the Border Defense Agency fights back with advanced tech.

seasons.title: World Trigger 3rd Season
seasons.description: Alien invaders threaten Mikado City, but the Border Defense Agency fights back with advanced tech.

seasons.title: Attack on Titan Junior High
seasons.description: Your favorite characters from Attack on Titan are back in…junior high school? Adapted from the hit spinoff manga series—Attack on Titan: Junior High (written by Saki Nakagawa), this parody reimagines Eren, Mikasa, Armin, and other characters from the original manga as students and teachers at Titan Junior High School.

seasons.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
seasons.description: Hope’s Peak High School only accepts the best of the best. Graduates of this elite yet enigmatic academy have the world at their fingertips, but getting a cap and gown involves getting away with murder—literally! Students will put each other on trial, face overwhelming despair, and try to avoid leaving school in a body bag. For these kids, school days are killing days.

seasons.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer!: Season 2
Umamusume: Pretty Derby
seasons.description: This is a tale of a world where "horse girls"; with glorious names and incredible running abilities live alongside humanity. Horse girl Special Week has moved from the country to the city to attend Tracen Academy. There, she and her classmates compete to win the Twinkle Series and earn the title of "The County’s #1 Horse Girl."

seasons.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby Season 2
seasons.description: This is a tale of a world where "horse girls"; with glorious names and incredible running abilities live alongside humanity. Horse girl Special Week has moved from the country to the city to attend Tracen Academy. There, she and her classmates compete to win the Twinkle Series and earn the title of "The County’s #1 Horse Girl."

seasons.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby Season 3
seasons.description: This is a tale of a world where "horse girls"; with glorious names and incredible running abilities live alongside humanity. Horse girl Special Week has moved from the country to the city to attend Tracen Academy. There, she and her classmates compete to win the Twinkle Series and earn the title of "The County’s #1 Horse Girl."

seasons.title: HINAMATSURI
seasons.description: Yakuza member Yoshifumi Nitta’s life takes a turn when an odd young girl falls onto his head. Following their strange first meeting, Nitta discovers that the girl possesses strong telekinetic abilities and, despite his protests, has no choice but to care for her. For better or for worse, they’ll try to keep their newly formed partnership from blowing up in their faces.

seasons.title: Gridman Universe
seasons.description: After Gridman has saved their world, Yuta, Rikka, and Utsumi return to everyday life. But Yuta has no memory of his time as Gridman’s host. Only Rikka and Utsumi remember what happened and decide to recount the events through a school play. When Yuta reads the script, he begins to hear and see things no one else can. Then, a Kaiju attacks, and Yuta fuses with the colossal hero once again.

seasons.title: Isekai Quartet
seasons.description: The button appeared out of nowhere. There weren’t any signs NOT to push it…so the solution is obvious, right? Is it a trap or the start of something new and exciting? The crews of Re:Zero, Overlord, Konosuba, and The Saga of Tanya the Evil will find out when they go from their world to another and get stuck in…class?! See what adorable chaos they’ll get up to in this collection of shorts!

seasons.title: Isekai Quartet2
seasons.description: Your favorite isekai characters return for more exciting crossovers in our everyday world! This time the Shield Hero joins in, and he’s brought Raphtalia and Filo along with him. What kind of shenanigans will the crews of Re:Zero, Overlord, KonoSuba, Saga of Tanya the Evil, and now, The Rising of the Shield Hero get into together?

seasons.title: Isekai Quartet3
seasons.description: The button appeared out of nowhere. Was it a trap or the start of something new? The crews of Re:ZERO, Overlord, KONOSUBA, and Saga of Tanya the Evil got stuck in another world’s class! Now, more new characters join the series, including Alpha and Shadow from The Eminence in Shadow. See what adorable chaos they’ll get up to in this collection of shorts!

seasons.title: We Never Learn: BOKUBEN
seasons.description: Nariyuki Yuiga needs a special scholarship, but he has to tutor three genius girls to get it! One is a literary virtuoso, but her skills in science are lacking. Another excels in math, but the arts are in her heart. The last one’s athletic prowess is unmatched, but she struggles with everything else. With university application deadlines coming up, can Nariyuki teach the unteachable in time?

seasons.title: We Never Learn: BOKUBEN
seasons.description: Nariyuki tutors genius classmates in their weakest subjects, battling academic and emotional turmoil.

seasons.title: THE iDOLM@STER SideM
seasons.description: 315 Production – a newly set up small talent agency – has assembled a group of aspiring male idols from various occupational fields. They include a former lawyer, a former doctor, former pilot and so on… Even though everyone hails from different background, they share a common dream: to be the top idol. And so, the stories of these male idols at 315 Production take centre stage…

seasons.title: Gonna Be the Twin-Tail!!
seasons.description: Soji Mitsuka is an ordinary high schooler with an extraordinary obsession. Twin tails are his fire, his air, his will to live! But when a mysterious woman from another world enlists his help to fight hideous monsters with various moe fetishes, Soji much transform into a powerful pigtailed…girl?

seasons.title: Comical Psychosomatic Medicine
seasons.description: Have issues with depression, erectile disfunction, dementia, or even with your love life? Don't worry, as the psychologist Ryo and his nurse Asuna will seriously try to help you understand these mental disorders all while laughing in this comedy anime!

seasons.title: Wonder Momo
seasons.description: One day, a group of aliens planning to take over Earth invade Tokyo. Momoko, who aspires to be an idol, gets involved in the fight in an unexpected form. Warudemon, king of the alien empire, uses various tactics to hunt down Momoko and the people around her. Momoko then decides to stand up to the Warudemon, plain and simple.

seasons.title: Persona4 the Golden ANIMATION
seasons.description: Spring. Far from the city, time flows peacefully in this rural town. As the cherry blossoms scatter, Yu Narukami steps off the train at Yasoinaba Station. Yu has come here for family reasons and begins his school life at Yasogami High. But soon a series of murders take place, and the Midnight Channel begins to air late at night. What lies in store for Yu and his friends this time around?

seasons.title: PUNCH LINE
seasons.description: Glimpsing panties means the extinction of the human race?! High school student Yuta Iridatsu has an unfortunate, idiosyncratic condition.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: A little girl with blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain skin fights on the front lines of a brutal war set in a fantasy world. What others don’t know is that she’s a reincarnated Japanese office worker whose career-driven attitude and ruthless drive to conquer have carried over into Tanya’s life. With such a unique set of skills, Tanya begins to climb the ranks of the imperial army.

seasons.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil - the Movie -
seasons.description: Tanya begins her aviation mage training, but a twist disrupts her path to a brilliant military career.

seasons.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta
seasons.description: Tanya's battalion embarks on a daring mission to secure supplies, but desert combat poses new challenges.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: A little girl with blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain skin fights on the front lines of a brutal war set in a fantasy world. What others don’t know is that she’s a reincarnated Japanese office worker whose career-driven attitude and ruthless drive to conquer have carried over into Tanya’s life. With such a unique set of skills, Tanya begins to climb the ranks of the imperial army.

seasons.title: Guyver: The Bioboosted Armor
seasons.description: While investigating a mysterious explosion, Sho Fukamachi discovers the Chronos Corporation's greatest weapon: a techno-organic suit of bio-armor known as the Guyver. With Chronos determined to conceal its secrets, Sho finds himself relentlessly pursued by an army of horrific bio-monsters. When he runs out of options, Sho is forced to call upon the fearsome powers of the Guyver.

seasons.title: Desert Punk
seasons.description: The Great Kanto Desert is a miserable place. It’s also the home of hero-for-hire Desert Punk, the closest thing to a good guy the wasteland’s got. He’s known as the best man for any job, but his reputation is undone by his raging hormones when curvy Junko uses her double-D charms to double-cross him. With debt hanging over his head, Desert Punk sets out to salvage his name.

seasons.title: Code: Realize ~Guardian of Rebirth~
seasons.description: Cardia has spent her life locked away in solitude, hidden from others due to a deadly poison that lies within her. But everything changes when she's suddenly abducted by the royal guards! Before she can despair, she's rescued and swept away by Arsène Lupin, a dashing and chivalrous thief. Together, they'll travel to London to find her father and answers about her mysterious condition.

seasons.title: A Sister's All You Need.
seasons.description: Itsuki Hashima is a novelist whose life is complicated by a deranged group of friends including a lusty fellow writer, an older sister-like classmate, a sadistic tax accountant, and his editor. The only source of stability in his life is his younger stepbrother, Chihiro. But even Chihiro has a secret of his own.

seasons.title: NARUTO Spin-Off: Rock Lee & His Ninja Pals
seasons.description: Welcome to the Hidden Leaf Village. The village where Uzumaki Naruto, star of the TV show "Naruto" makes his home. Every day, countless powerful ninjas carry out missions and train to hone their skills. Our main character is one of these powerful ninjas...but it's not Naruto! It's the ninja who can't use ninjutsu, Rock Lee!

seasons.title: The World God Only Knows: Goddesses
seasons.description: Keima, a high school student, is an avid player of romantic simulation games. He is known on the Internet as the "Divine Capturer" for his legendary skills to "capture" any 2D girl in games. In his real school life, Keima is considered nothing but a gloomy geek with thick glasses.

seasons.title: Kyousougiga
seasons.description: In a "mirror city" that is Kyoto and yet not Kyoto, where humans, monsters, and robots all live, 14-year-old Koto searches for her mother. She encounters a monk named Myoe who's waiting for his father to return. Family and the mirror city itself are at stake as this action fantasy unfolds.

seasons.title: Dog & Scissors
seasons.description: A book-loving man reincarnates as a dachshund, encountering a sadistic novelist who can hear his thoughts.

seasons.title: Skull-face Bookseller Honda-san
seasons.description: Honda-san is at war - with business, with out-of-print books, and with people who love manga! Who knew there were so many laughs to be found at the manga counter of a bookstore?! These are the day-to-day happenings that take place at a certain bookstore where the love of manga is abundant.

seasons.title: FLCL Progressive
seasons.description: FLCL: Progressive tells the story of 14-year-old Hidomi, her classmate Ide, and two otherworldly beings, "Jinyu" and "Haruha Raharu," who are determined to unlock their hidden potential. Mixed up in this is an all-powerful force known as "ATOMSK," a gorgeous Chrysler Bel Aire… and a certain Vespa Scooter.

seasons.title: FLCL Alternative
seasons.description: Kana's dull life changes when a Mecha and a mysterious woman named Haruko crash into her world.

seasons.title: Squid Girl
seasons.description: A squid girl seeks revenge on humanity but faces unexpected challenges out of water.

seasons.title: Squid Girl
seasons.description: A squid girl seeks revenge on humanity but faces unexpected challenges out of water.

seasons.title: Saki
seasons.description: Saki tells the story of a girl's mental and emotional growth as she and her fellow teammates battle fearsome rivals, all gunning for the national high school mahjong tournament, and is a cross between sports action and high school drama.

seasons.title: Saki: The Nationals
seasons.description: Saki tells the story of a girl's mental and emotional growth as she and her fellow teammates battle fearsome rivals, all gunning for the national high school mahjong tournament, and is a cross between sports action and high school drama.

seasons.title: Ixion Saga DT
seasons.description: The protagonist, Hokaze Kon, is sent to another world called Mira, the home of a mysterious energy known as Alma.

seasons.title: Sound! Euphonium
seasons.description: Spring in the first year of high school. Kumiko, a member of the brass band in junior high school, visits the high school brass band club with classmates Hazuki and Sapphire. They decide to join the club, but Kumiko can’t make up her mind.

seasons.title: Sound! Euphonium
seasons.description: Kumiko revisits her musical past, confronting old rivals and new challenges in the high school brass band.

seasons.title: Sound! Euphonium Season 3
seasons.description: After Kumiko Oumae’s fabled first year with the Kitauji High School Ensemble, the club’s results in her second year leave everyone feeling discouraged. Determined to turn the club around and win the gold at nationals, Kumiko takes her role as club president seriously and works alongside the instructor, Noboru Taki, to get the ensemble in shape. They’ll take home the gold at the nationals yet!

seasons.title: Special Feature - Ensemble Contest
seasons.description: Kumiko prepares the band for the upcoming ensemble contest.

seasons.title: How to Keep a Mummy
seasons.description: Sora's life changes when his adventurer dad sends him a tiny, adorable mummy named Mii-kun.

seasons.title: Free! -Iwatobi Swim Club-
seasons.description: After a run-in with former teammate Rin ends in bitter feelings and hurtful words, Haruka and his friends become determined to re-form the Iwatobi Swim Club. There’s just one problem—they’re missing a much-needed fourth member! With their eyes set on the athletic Rei, they’ve got to do what it takes to convince him to join so they can be in fighting form to face Rin’s new school, Samezuka Academy.

seasons.title: Free! -Eternal Summer-
seasons.description: A new swimming season is here, and Haru, Makoto, Nagisa, and Rei are anxious to get back in the pool. But things aren’t all flip-turns and finish lines. Haru’s passion for swimming is drying up, and with their futures looming ahead, Makoto and Haru are having a hard time focusing. And a new Samezuka student appears just in time to jeopardize Iwatobi’s chance at nationals.

seasons.title: Free! -Dive to the Future-
seasons.description: Your favorite swimming boys are back! While starting college and figuring out what they want for their future, Haru and Makoto run into the unexpected—their old teammates from middle school. Still hurt from their team suddenly dissolving, Ikuya is out to prove he’s better than Haru. But he’s not the only threat that lies in the waters of competition!

seasons.title: Wanna be the Strongest in the World!
seasons.description: The eye-popping world of women’s professional wrestling is sweaty, sadistic, and savagely sexy. Famous Japanese pop idol Sakura Hagiwara is better suited for the spotlight than the wrestling ring, but this ravishing songstress is about to put her body to the ultimate test.

seasons.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
seasons.description: Although born with tremendous power, Itadori Yuji lives a completely ordinary life. One day, to save a classmate, he eats a cursed finger, and now Ryomen Sukuna lives in Itadori’s soul. Guided by the Jujutsu Sorcerers, he joins the Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School, an organization that fights the curses. Now begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to end a curse.
seasons.availability_notes: [link url="https://bit.ly/2K0U62d"]You've Watched the Anime, Now Read the Manga! Manga Available in Print and Digital from VIZ![/link]

seasons.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 2
seasons.description: The past comes to light when second-year students Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto are tasked with escorting young Riko Amanai to Master Tengen. But when a non-sorcerer user tries to kill them, their mission to protect the Star Plasma Vessel threatens to turn them into bitter enemies and cement their destinies—one as the world’s strongest sorcerer, and the other its most twisted curse user!

seasons.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN: Hidden Inventory / Premature Death – The Movie
seasons.description: The past comes to light when second-year students Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto are tasked with escorting young Riko Amanai to Master Tengen. But when a non-sorcerer tries to kill them, their mission to protect the Star Plasma Vessel threatens to turn them into bitter enemies and cement their destinies—one as the world’s strongest sorcerer, and the other its most twisted curse user!

seasons.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 3
seasons.description: After the unprecedented battle of curses in the Shibuya Incident, the worst sorcerer in history, Noritoshi Kamo, appears. He sets the Culling Game in motion, trapping sorcerers in a deadly battle royale. Meanwhile, Yuji Itadori faces execution at the hands of the Special Grade Sorcerer, Yuta Okkotsu. Chaos builds as the two sorcerers, trained by the same master, prepare to fight to the death.

seasons.title: Season 1 Part 1
seasons.description: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

seasons.title: Season 1 Part 2
seasons.description: Even broken arms aren’t enough to stop Asta! When the Diamond Kingdom threatens the Clover Kingdom with their Shining Generals, Asta is ready to join in the fight and help protect his kingdom. After all, not giving up is his magic!

seasons.title: Season 1 Part 3
seasons.description: Elves invade the Clover Kingdom, but Asta’s newest sword could be the key to stopping them. As the battle rages, the Magic Knights come face to face with an even greater threat—a devil! After one is defeated, the Black Bulls’ mission to find the rest brings them to the Spade Kingdom. Now the Magic Knights have six months to come up with an attack plan, and they’re going to need all the elements!

seasons.title: Season 1 Part 4
seasons.description: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

seasons.title: OVA
seasons.description: The Magic Knight captains (and special guests) take time out of their busy schedules to compete in a spirited quiz show hosted by Finral and Charmy.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

seasons.title: Dies Irae
seasons.description: At the end of World War II, sorcerers use the lives lost in battle as a ritual sacrifice in an attempt to resurrect a group of supermen whose coming would signify the world’s end. Yet when the war finally ends, no one knows whether the ritual was a success. Decades pass, and it’s all forgotten until present-day Japan when Ren Fuji has a disturbing dream of black-clothed knights.

seasons.title: Sabagebu! - Survival Game Club! –
seasons.description: The story of Hidekichi Matsumoto's original Sabagebu! manga, which is running in Kodansha's Nakayoshi shojo magazine, revolves around Momoka Sonokawa, a girl who transferred into a certain girls' high school. The club she ended up joining at school was the "Sabagebu!," a club that conducts survival games.

seasons.title: Schwarzes Marken
seasons.description: A ruthless squad battles alien BETA forces, following orders at all costs, even ignoring allies in distress.

seasons.title: Anime de Training! Ex
seasons.description: Five girls who are aiming to become idols, lead the viewer through practicing various types of training, such as push-up, sit-up, back extension, dance, yoga, stretch, trunk training, and Tai Chi, while talking to viewers.

seasons.title: Samurai Flamenco
seasons.description: Masayoshi Hazama is a man who became a superhero “by himself” with no superhuman powers or high-tech gadgets. None! Hidenori Goto is a cop who found out Hazama’s true identity by a strange twist of fate and now constantly gets in trouble because of him. This is the story of two heroes coming face to face with hardships as they search for the true meaning of justice in the world!

seasons.title: Miss Monochrome - The Animation
seasons.description: In this short animated series, Miss Monochrome is an android who decides to try and become a top idol singer in the ever growing competitive market.

seasons.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
seasons.description: Outcast Natsume inherited his grandmother Reiko’s ability to see yokai, strange beings that are invisible to most people. After moving to his grandmother’s hometown and accidentally releasing an imprisoned yokai, he learns about his grandmother's “Book of Friends,” which contains the names of the yokai she defeated. Since then, his life has gotten significantly more hectic…

seasons.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
seasons.description: Natsume, with the help of his self-proclaimed bodyguard, Nyanko-sensei, spends his days returning the names of yokai from his grandmother's Book of Friends.

seasons.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
seasons.description: Takashi Natsume has always been shunned by those around him because of his mysterious ability to see yokai. But once in possession of his grandmother Reiko’s “Book of Friends,” and together with his bodyguard Nyanko-sensei, he sets out to return the names of the yokai contained within it. Little does he know, he's about to be dragged unwittingly into further trouble...

seasons.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
seasons.description: Still in possession of his grandmother's Book of Friends, Natsume spends his days returning the names of yokai to their rightful owners. He has been learning how to deal with the yokai and humans that surround his life, but the time has come for him to deal with something even more difficult—his own past, and future.

seasons.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
seasons.description: Natsume, aided by Nyanko-sensei, returns youkai names, forging bonds and finding a sense of belonging.

seasons.title: Natsume's Book of Friends
seasons.description: Precious days with kinds friends. A beautiful yet fleeting story about people and spirits. Natsume Takashi had been able to see yokai ever since he was young and inherited his grandmother Reiko’s Book of Friends. He spends his days with his self-proclaimed bodyguard Nyanko-sensei and freeing the yokai that were bound to the book. Natsume continues to find ways to protect the precious days where...

seasons.title: Katsugeki TOUKEN RANBU
seasons.description: In 1863 Japan, pro-and anti-shogunate factions clash as the era of swords comes to a close. Manifesting as Sword Warriors, Horikawa Kunihiro and Izuminokami Kanesada awaken to protect the world from the Time Retrograde Army—soldiers sent to alter history. Banding together with other warriors, they devote themselves to defeating this future army. The fate of history lies in these heroes’ hands.

seasons.title: TSUKIUTA. The Animation 2
seasons.description: Twelve young men. Two rival idol groups. One roof. The members of Six Gravity and Procellarum will have to learn how to live together in peace. From idol-hood to school days, follow the lives of these young men, who each represent a month of the year.

seasons.title: Anime Crimes Division
seasons.description: In Neo Otaku City, there are two kinds of people. The kind of people that can recite the Sailor Moon theme song from memory in the original Japanese, and the kind that don't belong there. When someone commits a crime against anime, they don't call the police. They call: the Anime Crimes Division.

When someone commits a crime against anime, they don't call the police. They call: the Anime Crimes Division.

seasons.title: Zaion: I Wish You Were Here
seasons.description: In the future, a meteor unleashes a spaceborne disease that turns people into monsters. With the help of nanomachines and remote-controlled robots, Earth is able to fight back, but the viruses mutate. Now with humanity on the brink of extinction, hope lies in a 16-year-old girl with a unique power.

seasons.title: RErideD - Derrida, who leaps through time -
seasons.description: Engineer Derrida awakens in a future ravaged by his own creations, fighting to protect a promise and survive.

seasons.title: Magical Sempai
seasons.description: Sempai's magic tricks fail hilariously due to stage fright and I join the Magic Club as her assistant.

seasons.title: given the Movie
seasons.description: After a chance encounter with the singer Mafuyu Sato, Ritsuka Uenoyama’s passion for music was reignited. Their band, Given, is on the path to greatness just as Mafuyu begins to question if he should be the group’s singer. After declining Ritsuka’s invitation to a concert in Shibuya, Mafuyu runs into an old friend. Could this be the sign Mafuyu needs to step up to the microphone once more?

seasons.title: given The Movie: Hiiragi Mix
seasons.description: Ritsuka Uenoyama met Mafuyu Sato and Ritsuka's passion towards music was reignited. Mafuyu's singing and Ritsuka's guitar playing... That's what finally moved the band ""given"" forward. But Mafuyu's past and his feelings towards Ritsuka intersect yet again and the distance between them starts to change.

seasons.description: Waver Velvet has grown since his time in the Fourth Holy Grail War and has taken on the mantle of Lord El-Melloi II. But when he’s ready to claim his inheritance of Adra Castle, he learns he must compete in a game of wits to win it from other contestants.

seasons.description: Demon King Daimao follows Akuto Sai as the lead character, who on the day he enters Constant Magic Academy, receives a very unexpected future occupation aptitude test result: “Devil King.”

seasons.title: Fushigi Yugi
seasons.description: Miaka, a junior high school student in Tokyo, has normal problems: fights with her mom, entrance exams, and deciding where she's going to go eat with her friends. But when she finds a mysterious book in the library, her life is changed forever when she and her best friend are transported inside!

seasons.title: Fushigi Yugi OVA
seasons.description: The Mystical book "The Universe of the Four Gods" was finally closed when Miaka made her last wish or so everyone had thought. But the old enemies have returned from beyond the grave to claim their revenge. This time Tamahome is drawn into the book to become one of the Seiryu Seven.

seasons.title: OVAs (1997)

seasons.title: Season 1: Director's Cut
seasons.description: When Natsuki Subaru is transported to another world, he discovers a terrible ability—he can’t die. Instead, he experiences the pain of death and resets which begins to destroy his mind. But with new friends and a new love, Subaru will suffer to save.

seasons.title: OVAs
seasons.description: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school tudent, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds himself transported to another world. As he's lost and confused in a new world where he doesn't even know left from right, the only person to reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to help...

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: Rem’s in a coma, and Subaru is the only person who remembers her. But this time, his power can’t bring her back. Desperate for solutions, Subaru follows a lead to the Sanctuary, where he meets the Witch of Greed and begins a trilogy of harrowing trials.

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: A year has passed since Subaru’s victory at the Sanctuary. He savors a life of fulfillment while Emilia’s camp stands united for the royal selection—until a fateful letter arrives. Anastasia, a royal selection candidate, has invited Emilia to the Watergate City of Priestella. But as the party begins its journey, crisis stirs beneath the surface and Subaru meets a cruel fate once again.

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.description: In the deadly battle at Priestella, Subaru and his allies emerged victorious, but at great cost. As Subaru searches for a way to save Rem, Crusch, and Julius, he learns of a “wise woman,” Shaula, an all-seeing being said to possess every form of knowledge, who resides at the Pleiades Watchtower. Subaru and his crew must brave the uncharted Auguria Dunes to reclaim what was lost.

seasons.title: Wakakozake
seasons.description: Wakako, a food-loving office worker, explores eateries after work, savoring perfect food and drink pairings.

seasons.title: KOWABON
seasons.description: The world is filled with cameras. Their "eyes" have been seeing a world you didn't know existed.

seasons.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS (Original Japanese Version)
seasons.description: In “Den City” where the latest network has developed, people were dueling day and night in the VR world called "LINK VRAINS" managed by SOL Technology Inc. The main character, Yusaku Fujiki is a quiet high school student with a great insight. He has been dueling, transforming himself into his avatar "Playmaker", to battle the "The Knights of Hanoi” that plots to destroy "LINK VRAINS".

seasons.title: DOUBLE DECKER! DOUG & KIRILL
seasons.description: Kirill Vrubelis just an average detective looking to prove he’s a hero. But when he meets up with Doug Billingham of the SEVEN-O unit, he gets a chance to show his stuff—literally! Now the two will work closely together to face users of the deadly drug Anthem and protect the city state of Lisvalletta! Can this veteran and rookie team clean up the streets or are they bound to make more of a mess?

seasons.title: DOUBLE DECKER! DOUG & KIRILL: OVA Season 1
Kaguya-sama: Love is War
seasons.description: Known for being both brilliant and powerful, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya lead the illustrious Shuchiin Academy as near equals. And everyone thinks they’d make a great couple. Pride and arrogance are in ample supply, so the only logical move is to trick the other into instigating a date! Who will come out on top in this psychological war where the first move is the only one that matters?

seasons.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War?
seasons.description: People think Miyuki and Kaguya should date. However, arrogance is in ample supply, so the only move is to trick the other into acting first!

seasons.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War -Ultra Romantic-
seasons.description: Elite students Kaguya and Miyuki's love war escalates, each too proud to confess. Who will break first?

seasons.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War: Season 3.5: The First Kiss That Never Ends - Episodic Cut
Kaguya-sama: Love Is War -Stairway to Adulthood-
seasons.description: Kaguya’s birthday is just around the corner, and Fujiwara has come up with (what she thinks is) the perfect surprise: pretending that she and Shirogane are dating. Unfortunately for Shirogane, he and Kaguya have been secretly dating for real! Now Shirogane scrambles to keep everything under wraps, but when Kaguya suddenly shows up and does the unthinkable, everything takes a shocking turn!

seasons.title: As Miss Beelzebub Likes it.
seasons.description: Mullin lands his dream job as the assistant to Beelzebub, a demon banished from Heaven to rule over Pandemonium. Soon after starting, his assumptions are proved wrong. Though Beelzebub is a wise ruler, she’s also just a girl who loves fluffy things! Her dedication to her job is only rivaled by her love for everything fluffy. Mullin learns everything is not as it seems in Pandemonium.

seasons.title: ZOMBIE LAND SAGA
seasons.description: Sakura Minamoto is dead. The good kind of dead where she can still head-bang to heavy metal. She and six other long-lost celebs were sprung from the grave to form an idol group that will put their tiny town on the map! But when the crowd comes begging for more, can Sakura and her zom squad put on a show that will knock 'em dead?

seasons.title: ZOMBIE LAND SAGA REVENGE
seasons.description: Everyone’s favorite zombie idol group is back (from the dead) for another tour! It’s a new year and a new era in Japan, and Sakura Minamoto and the other members of Franchouchou are more determined than ever to save Saga Prefecture with their growing fame…while recovering long-lost memories of their past lives.

seasons.title: Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc and the Alchemist Knight
seasons.description: Montmorency is a nobleman devoted to the study of sorcery and alchemy at a royal knight training school in Paris. He’s used to a hectic lifestyle, but his fate, and that of his country, changes completely when France is defeated at the Battle of Agincourt. War leads to the school’s shutdown, and the newly wanted Montmorency flees to a village where he meets a mysterious young woman named Jeanne.

seasons.title: Oda Cinnamon Nobunaga
seasons.description: The Warring States Period is a time of feuding warlords. Oda Nobunaga, the greatest of them all, is reborn in modern-day Japan... as a shiba-inu! The other generals of the era, too, have also inexplicably been reborn as dogs. Their warring states rivalry will resume at the dog park!

seasons.title: Iwakakeru -Sport Climbing Girls-
seasons.description: Konomi finds her puzzle in climbing walls, racing to the top with her high school team.

seasons.title: Red Garden
seasons.description: Kate, Claire, Rose, and Rachel once explored the streets of New York with the promise of limitless futures unfolding before them. But now, murdered and resurrected as killers, they must silence demonic beasts no ordinary weapon can destroy—or risk losing what remains of their so-called lives.

seasons.title: Our love has always been 10 centimeters apart.
seasons.description: The moment Miou Aida first met Haruki Serizawa at the Sakuragaoka High School Entrance Ceremony they both felt an unexplainable connection. Despite their completely different personalities, they found themselves walking home together after school every day. As they spend more time together, their feelings for each other grow stronger. Just 10 centimeters apart, but the distance remains...

seasons.title: Plastic Memories
seasons.description: Eighteen-year-old Tsukasa Mizugaki has failed his college entrance exams! But his father’s connections at the renowned SAI Corporation open the door to a position in the Terminal Service department. Known for their production of androids with human emotions called Giftia, Tsukasa is ordered to work with Isla, a female Giftia who was never given any responsibilities outside serving tea.

seasons.title: OZMAFIA!!
seasons.description: Fuuka is an amnesiac. As she wanders through the unfamiliar town, she realizes that she's being chased. It's one of the mafia families running the town -- the Oz family -- that saves her. In a town where friendship and fighting exist together, Fuuka must decide who's hand to accept. And then there's the question: why doesn't she remember anything?

seasons.title: Burst Angel
seasons.description: The future’s looking bleak. It’s a good thing there’s a new sheriff in town. Her name is Jo and she’s an enigma even to herself. Alongside her partners Sei, Amy, and Meg, Jo fights for the citizens who can’t defend themselves. Confronting corruption and twisted science, these gals are on fire—and they’re the best chance the wounded city’s got.

seasons.title: Seton Academy: Join the Pack!
seasons.description: Jin Mazama, an animal-hating human, joins Seton Academy, where species clash and survival is key.

seasons.title: Asteroid in Love
seasons.description: Mira is lucky enough to share her name with a star, but her friend’s name “Ao” is starless. Now that Mira’s entering high school, she’s determined to make a celestial discovery and name it after her friend. Only one thing stands in her way. The astronomy club is disbanded!

seasons.description: Monkey D. Luffy refuses to let anyone or anything stand in the way of his quest to become the king of all pirates. With a course charted for the treacherous waters of the Grand Line and beyond, this is one captain who'll never give up until he's claimed the greatest treasure on Earth: the Legendary One Piece!

seasons.title: One Piece HEROINES Special
seasons.description: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

seasons.description: Monkey. D. Luffy refuses to let anyone or anything stand in the way of his quest to become the king of all pirates. seasons.title: World Break: Aria of Curse for a Holy Swordsman
seasons.description: Welcome to Akane Academy where our unlikely hero, Moroha Haimura, has just enrolled. Moroha quickly learns to harness the magical powers of his two past lives, which he must use to fend off fantastic, evil beasts. His trouble with women might be an understatement, but that won’t stop Moroha from learning the secrets of his former lives to help protect the fate of the world!

seasons.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Season 2
Orenchi no Furo Jijo
seasons.description: A hot boy mermaid named Wakasa has taken over the bath of a teenage boy named Tatsumi! This cute but selfish freeloader is a perfect match for the cool but tender and caring Tatsumi. Let's see how they get by together!
seasons.availability_notes: [link url="http://www.gomanga.com/books/merman-in-my-tub/606"]Read the original manga, Merman in my Tub, available from Seven Seas Entertainment![/link]

seasons.title: Junjo Romantica
seasons.description: Misaki is trying to prepare for his college entrance exams, but his nightmare is just beginning when his tutor comes on to him! Just when Kamijou's life is at its lowest, he meets Nowaki. He's about to take Kamijou on a whirlwind ride. Shinobu is adamant that he and Miyagi are destined to be together. Three very different couples caught up in a storm of romance!

seasons.title: Junjo Romantica 2
seasons.description: Three intertwining love stories threaten to unravel. Misaki and Usami’s relationship is tested when Usami's brother appears. Nowaki is afraid Hiroki doesn't feel the same way. Shinobu’s zest for Miyagi seems to have mysteriously faded.

seasons.title: KAGEWANI
seasons.description: An original series that’s part of the Ultra Super Anime Time, Kagewani is being directed by Tomoya Takashima and written by Hiromu Kumamoto, both of whom have had plenty of experience with creepy suspense anime shorts, having both worked on the Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories series. The plot centers on mysterious monsters called “UMA” that suddenly appear and start attacking humans.

seasons.description: An original series that’s part of the Ultra Super Anime Time, Kagewani is being directed by Tomoya Takashima and written by Hiromu Kumamoto, both of whom have had plenty of experience with creepy suspense anime shorts, having both worked on the Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories series. seasons.description: Our IDOL friends are back again today! Get a rare look at how IDOLS spend their days off, as well as their comical interactions with each other in this hyper-fun-filled short anime.

seasons.title: AHO-GIRL
seasons.description: She is Hanabatake Yoshiko, and she's an idiot through and through. She loves bananas, and she loves her childhood friend Akkun. That is all! Summer 2017, Aho Girl gets its long-awaited anime! Watching it will surely cheer you up, probably?

seasons.title: GA Geijutsuka Art Design Class
seasons.description: GA Geijutsuka Art Design Class is a Japanese seinen yonkoma manga series by Satoko Kiyuzuki. The series was serialized in Heiwa Shuppan's moe four-panel manga magazine Comic Gyutto!

seasons.title: Pikotaro's LULLABY LA LA BY (TV)
seasons.description: Pikotaro reimagines classic fairy tales in whimsical, scriptless shorts, sure to lull you into absurd dreams.

seasons.title: Pikotaro's Lullaby La La By: OVA Season 1
Code Geass - Akito the Exiled
seasons.description: Leila Malcal, commander of her very own W-0 unit for the European army, takes on dangerous missions with her powerful and mysterious lieutenant, Akito Hyuga. With a group of rebels on their side, they fight the Britannian army but face more than the typical perils of war. A foe from Akito’s past seeks his life and a dark power threatens all that Leila has worked for.

seasons.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO
seasons.description: When an assassination attempt destroys the delicate peace between the humans of Earth and Mars, their 15-year ceasefire is over. Armed with advanced alien technology, the Vers Empire of Mars launches an attack beyond measure. Earth hardly stands a chance, unless high school student Inaho and his friends can rise to the occasion.

seasons.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO
seasons.description: Humanity has clearly split into two and currently there is no way these groups will once again unite. Humanity celebrates this transient time of peace as they slowly dismiss from their minds the scars their ancestors bore in the past. No one realized that with one little push their world can fall to its destruction.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Izumi, a manga-loving college student, is mistaken for a girl by actor Ryoma, sparking a complex love story.

seasons.title: Ai-Mai-Mi Mousou Catastrophe
seasons.description: The loveable manga club girls are back! Ai, Mai, Mii, and Ponoka-senpai who might be fighting evil invaders threatening Earth, facing off against rivals in tournaments, and dealing with other absurd situations when they are not drawing manga!

seasons.title: BURN THE WITCH
seasons.description: Invisible to most people, dragons have become responsible for the majority of deaths in London. Witch duo Ninny Spangcole and Noel Niihashi are protection agents at Wing Bind who secretly help keep the peace in Front London while managing dragons in Reverse London.

seasons.title: THE iDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS
seasons.description: There are many idols with long-established talent agency 346 Production. And now the company is starting a new program, the Cinderella Project! Girls leading normal lives… They are chosen to be aspiring idols and see another world for the first time in this Cinderella story. Can they all climb the stairs that lead to the palace?

seasons.title: Magical Girl Raising Project
seasons.description: For the girls of N-City, being a magical girl is a dream come true! At least, online it is. When a lucky few are given the chance to be real-life magical heroines, their lives go from sweet to deadly. And after the city decides to halve the magical girl numbers, what once seemed like a race for glory becomes a desperate fight for survival. Cute turns wicked in the prettiest death game around.

seasons.title: Nyanbo!
seasons.description: Nyanbo are square aliens resembling cats who secretly live on Earth to fix their UFO and return home.

seasons.title: GTO - The Animation
seasons.description: Meet Eikichi Onizuka, a 22-year-old ex-biker and college karate champ. He's crude, foul-mouthed, and has a hair-trigger temper. His goal: to be the greatest high school teacher in the world! Unfortunately, the only teaching job available is at Holy Forest Academy (no certification required). There he uses his street smarts to deal with colleagues and students alike.

seasons.title: Saint Seiya Saintia Sho
seasons.description: Shoko's peaceful life is shattered by a mysterious attack, revealing a world of Saints and ancient gods.

seasons.title: ARP Backstage Pass
seasons.description: ARP: A 4-member dance and vocal group created by the latest AR technology. This popular group got their start with Avex, and are unique for their interactive concerts which combine highly-skilled song and dance routines with a format that changes based on how much the fans are cheering them on. And now, you can follow their rise to glory in the new anime, ARP Backstage Pass!

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Jin Mori, a young master of martial arts, claims to be the strongest high schooler around. His skills are put to the test when he’s invited to “God of High School,” a brutal tournament where students battle it out using borrowed power from the gods. Each participant is a formidable contender vying for the same prize: their greatest wish fulfilled. What awaits them at the end of it all?
seasons.availability_notes: Check out the original series on WEBTOON [link url="https://bit.ly/3gFyy6m"]here[/link]!

seasons.title: Behind the Scenes of The God of High School
seasons.description: Crunchyroll takes you into MAPPA studios to meet the team behind the scenes of The God of High School. We also talk to the original WEBTOON creator, Yongje Park, who talks about the collaborative process of creating this Crunchyroll Original series.

seasons.title: Nobunaga teacher's young bride
seasons.description: A teacher's life turns upside down when a 14-year-old princess from the past claims to be his wife.

seasons.title: Nobunaga teacher's young bride
seasons.description: "One day, there'll be a girl who'll fall head over heels for me." Nobunaga was a teacher who was waiting for that kind of dating sim event to happen in real life. One day, a 14 year old girl named Kicho appears in front of him, saying that she's his wife?! Apparently she came from the Warring States era and seems to have mistaken Nobunaga for the Oda Nobunaga and tells him that she wants to...

seasons.title: ROOM CAMP
seasons.description: Join the Outdoor Activities Club for a laid-back adventure, exploring local eats and unexpected spots.

seasons.title: Lord of Vermilion: The Crimson King
seasons.description: In the year 2030, a high-frequency resonance echoes throughout Tokyo, followed by a red fog. Anyone that hears the sound falls unconscious, so the Japanese government puts Tokyo under quarantine. After six days, citizens awaken unharmed, and a sense of normalcy returns to the city. But when various young people develop blood-based supernatural powers, things take a turn for the sinister.

seasons.title: Angels of Death
seasons.description: When Rachel wakes up in the basement of an unfamiliar building, she finds she’s lost all her memory. As she tries to get clear of the basement, she runs into Zack, a scythe-carrying serial killer wrapped from head to toe in bandages. A bizarre promise brings these two together,and they become irreplaceable partners to each other. The journey of life and death begins...

seasons.title: GRANBLUE FANTASY: The Animation
seasons.description: Gran and Lyria embark on a thrilling sky adventure, escaping the Empire and seeking the Island of the Astrals.

seasons.title: GARO -VANISHING LINE-
seasons.description: An omen awakens in a city that never sleeps. Caught in the resulting shadow war, two lives cross paths. While Sword seeks to expose this darkness, Sophie searches for her missing brother. Something more mysterious than fate has brought them together as they chase after their only clue—El Dorado.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Welcome to the Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School, a facility dedicated to fostering the best and brightest for the future of Japan. Here, students are given nearly complete freedom—but at a cost. To survive, they’ve got to get the grades, stay out of trouble, and be the very best, lest they be left with nothing.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: Ayanokoji teams up with Horikita, who’s convinced she can ascend to a higher class. After surviving the island, they enjoy a luxury cruise—but a treacherous new test begins. Will students work for their class, their group, or themselves?

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: Kiyotaka Ayanokoji and his classmates have finally advanced to Class C, but a tumultuous third term lies ahead. They face an exam known as the “mixed training camp,” a co-ed test in which all classes must work together to achieve high scores. Not only are students forced into unpredictable groups with former enemies, but those who fail to reach the benchmark will be expelled!

seasons.title: 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester
seasons.description: Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School promises a perfect future, but only the strongest can claim it. After a crushing defeat sends Ayanokoji’s class back to Class D, they start their second year at the bottom yet again. As bonds deepen and loyalties shift, a new exam pairs them with incoming students—one of whom is a White Room assassin. A new semester of deception and strategy begins!

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Shiroe is sucked into the fantasy world of Akiba while playing his favorite MMORPG. Unable to log off, he discovers other Adventurers plagued with the same predicament. Lucking upon two of his friends, they venture out into this once-familiar world only to find it riddled with monsters and murderous “player killers.” What do you do when there’s no way out, and not even death is an escape?

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: Trapped in a game world, Shiroe forms Log Horizon, a guild of allies, to navigate chaos and uncover the truth.

seasons.title: Log Horizon: Destruction of the Round Table
seasons.description: It’s been a year since Shiroe and his friends were trapped in Akiba due to the Apocalypse. Their forging of the Round Table has brought order and prosperity to its people. But fracturing political alliances and the constant menace of the Genius monsters threaten to destabilize all they’ve fought for and built. Can faith be restored and they persevere, or is its destruction truly inevitable?

seasons.title: BLASSREITER
seasons.description: A plague races across Germany, giving life to Demoniacs—mechanized monsters hell-bent on leaving a trail of victims in their wake. Standing in their way is Joseph Jobson, the mysterious lone rider who fuses with his motorcycle to defend man against machine. But the same tainted blood that supplies his strength threatens to devour his soul, leaving him nothing more than a murderous demon.

seasons.title: March comes in like a lion
seasons.description: This is a gentle tale about people trying to regain something. And it is a tale of battle. Rei Kiriyama lost his family in an accident when he was young. Now he is a 17-year-old pro shogi player who is burdened with deep loneliness. Rei lives alone in an old town in Tokyo, but after becoming acquainted with three sisters, Akari, Hinata, and Momo, he begins to change little by little...

seasons.title: March comes in like a lion
seasons.description: This is a gentle tale about people trying to regain something. And it is a tale of battle. The main character, Rei Kiriyama, lost his family in an accident when he was young. Now he is a 17-year-old pro shogi player who is burdened with deep loneliness. Rei lives alone in an old town in Tokyo, but after becoming acquainted with three sisters, Akari, Hinata and Momo, he begins to change little...

seasons.title: A Certain Magical Index
seasons.description: In a city where science is used to develop supernatural abilities, Kamijo’s powers are laughably weak. Luckily for Index, the guy’s got a lot of heart. Index is running from sorcerers who want the magical knowledge stored in her memory. Kamijo wields the magic-negating power found in his hand against anyone who threatens Index – but it’s his loyalty that offers the best hope of keeping her safe.

seasons.title: A Certain Magical Index III
seasons.description: Academy City and the Roman Orthodox Church are at each other’s throats, and several independent groups are ready to take advantage of the chaos. Meanwhile, Toma is busy dealing with a very hungry Index and the deadly members of the Right Seat of God. Will Toma’s luck improve, or will his right hand be his undoing? The time is nigh to put Imagine Breaker to the test.

seasons.title: To the Abandoned Sacred Beasts
seasons.description: A nation splits, and forbidden powers create monster-like soldiers, igniting a deadly civil war.
seasons.availability_notes: [link url="https://kodanshacomics.com/series/to-abandoned-sacred-beasts/"]To the Abandoned Sacred Beasts manga available in print/digital! Read chapter 1 for FREE now![/link]

seasons.title: UMAYON
seasons.description: The horse girls are back to charm you in this special, bite-size anime. Umayon comes alive as a cute and eye-catching anime! At a school-turned-training facility, the girls will race, perform, and train... but that's not all! Saddle up for a short-form anime that displays the laidback school days of the horse girls! Aaaaand, they're off!

seasons.title: Bokurano
seasons.description: A group of middle schoolers fight a series of battles with giant robots from other dimensions in their own mecha Zearth, but each battle is lethal.

seasons.title: NEW GAME!!
seasons.description: Aoba Suzukaze starts another year designing characters at Eagle Jump, and she can’t wait to meet the newbie recruits…if any are hired. But before she can even unlock her senpai status, she finds herself in a lead designer position for the company’s newest game! Following in her manager’s footsteps, Aoba’s gotta get good if she wants her skills to compete with Ko Yagami’s.

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.description: Shin and Hyou are war-orphans in the kingdom of Qin. They dream of proving themselves on the battlefield until the day Hyou is captured by a minister. The boy manages to escape and return to his village, but he is badly injured. Shin then meets a mysterious youth who bears an eerie resemblance to Hyou—a boy who will one day become emperor!

seasons.title: Season 5
seasons.description: Ying Zheng is crowned king and continues his quest to reunify the Middle Kingdom, no matter the cost. Zheng’s army marches to Heiyang to face Huan Yi at the helm of the fierce Fei Xin Force. Xin gets his chance to prove himself in battle, and must face the feared general Qing She. War engulfs the valley as each side fights to take its five hills. When the dust settles, who will emerge victorious?

seasons.title: Season 6
seasons.description: Determined to build a new nation governed by law rather than lineage, King Ying Zheng allies with Lord Changping and Li Si to strike western Zhao. But with strategist Li Mu blocking their path, Qin shifts tactics and targets the city of Yè. With Zhao fighting tooth and nail to resist unification, Yè becomes a bloody battleground where the fate of nations will be decided—and legends will be born.

seasons.title: And you thought there is never a girl online?: Season 1
Pretear
seasons.description: Himeno was a normal sixteen-year old girl until seven men called the Leafe Knights burst into her life and revealed that she is a being known as the Pretear. Blessed with the power to merge with the Leafe Knights and wield their elemental powers, Himeno must aide her new friends in their quest to stop the evil Princess of Disaster!

seasons.title: Speed Grapher
seasons.description: In the new Tokyo, where every fetish has a face, burned-out war photographer Saiga is slumming in the tabloid wasteland. Sent to dig up dirt on the underground elite, he stumbles upon a depraved ritual below the city—and before the night ends, a single kiss from a young beauty named Kagura ignites a chain of events that could force the entire ruling class to their knees.

seasons.title: Akiba's Trip The Animation
seasons.description: Based off the hit game comes a new series about the danger lurking in the Otaku heaven of Akihabara. Vampires with an ability to take over anyone they bite seek their prey in this anime fan’s paradise. When Tamotsu Denkigai encounters one, he nearly loses his life until the mysterious Matome Mayonaka revives him! Now part vampire, he forms a group to protect the streets of Akiba.

seasons.title: THE UNLIMITED Hyobu Kyosuke
seasons.description: Hyoubu Kyousuke leads a psychic revolution, challenging fate for his kind. Will his power change the world?

seasons.title: Laid-Back Camp
seasons.description: It’s a cold winter day in Yamanashi, and Nadeshiko is riding her bike to see Mount Fuji. But before making it to the lookout point, she falls asleep! She wakes up in complete darkness and realizes she’s lost. Thankfully, she runs into a girl named Rin who’s solo camping and stays the night at her site. Sipping warm curry noodles around a crackling fire, Nadeshiko’s love for camping begins here.

seasons.title: Laid-Back Camp Season 2
seasons.description: Nadeshiko seeks Mount Fuji but gets lost. Rin, a solo camper, saves her, sparking an outdoor adventure.

seasons.title: Laid-Back Camp Season 3
seasons.description: After returning from Izu, the girls are ready for their next camping trip. Half of them visit the Oi River in Shizuoka—Rin and Ayano on two wheels and Nadeshiko by train. Chiaki, Aoi, and Ena’s scheduling conflicts lead them on their own trip among the cherry blossoms. The changing of the seasons, experiences they share, and hope for the future rekindle the girls’ spirits for the new school term.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Nasa Yuzaki falls in love at first sight after an encounter with the mysterious Tsukasa. When Nasa earnestly confesses his feelings, she replies, "I'll date you, but only if we're married." Nasa and Tsukasa's cute and precious newlywed life of love is about to begin!
seasons.availability_notes: [link url="https://www.viz.com/fly-me-to-the-moon"]Love the anime? Read the manga, Fly Me to the Moon, from VIZ today![/link]

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: The sweet story of Nasa and Tsukasa continues! After surviving some awkward first nights together, dealing with doubters, and recovering from their apartment fire, it’s clear the fate of these lovers was written in the stars. Now, they’re ready to settle back into domestic bliss and finally plan their wedding ceremony! But with plenty of new friends on the way, what will their big day look like?!

seasons.title: ~High School Days~
seasons.description: Nasa Yuzaki falls in love at first sight after an encounter with the mysterious Tsukasa. When Nasa earnestly confesses his feelings, she replies, "I'll date you, but only if we're married." Nasa and Tsukasa's cute and precious newlywed life of love is about to begin!

seasons.title: The Highschool Life of a Fudanshi
seasons.description: Sakaguchi is a regular high school boy, just like any other. He turns out to have a deep love for Boys' Love. He could live on Boys' Love alone! The Highschool Life of a Fudanshi is a hilarious slice-of-life comedy about Fudanshi Sakaguchi and his jolly gang.

seasons.title: SENGOKUCHOJYUGIGA
seasons.description: Popular young actors and a unique cast come together to have fun messing around and playing the roles of samurai generals. SENGOKUCHOJYUGIGA is an anime that plays around with both Japan's history and the generals of Japan's sengoku period!

seasons.title: SENGOKUCHOJYUGIGA (Season 2)
seasons.description: Popular young actors and a unique cast come together to have fun messing around and playing the roles of samurai generals. SENGOKUCHOJYUGIGA is an anime that plays around with both Japan's history and the generals of Japan's sengoku period!

seasons.title: A Bridge to the Starry Skies - Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi
seasons.description: Hoshino Kazuma moves from the city to rural Yamahiko Town for his younger brother Ayumu’s health. The brothers are supposed to stay at Yorozuyo Inn until their parents can join them, but get lost on the way. When Kazuma decides to go into the mountains alone after a small accident, a mysterious girl appears before him.

seasons.title: Strike the Blood
seasons.description: A legendary vampire surfaces, and an inexperienced shaman must observe and defeat it in the demon district.

seasons.title: Strike the Blood OVA
seasons.description: Strike the Blood OVA

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Extra Story -if-
seasons.description: Aichi's life changes when he reunites with Toshiki and discovers Vanguard and his rare "Blaster Blade" card.

seasons.title: GRANBELM
seasons.description: Mangetsu seeks her purpose, discovering magical dolls and a lunar rival in a world where magic has vanished.

seasons.title: Snow White With The Red Hair
seasons.description: In the kingdom of Tanbarun lives an independent young herbalist named Shirayuki. Shirayuki is a plain girl, save for her shock of beautiful apple-red hair. Her stunning mane gets her noticed by the prince, but instead of romancing her, he demands she be his concubine. Shirayuki chops off her lovely locks, and runs away to the neighboring kingdom where she befriends a handsome stranger.

seasons.title: Snow White With The Red Hair Season 2
seasons.description: Just as everything seemed to be falling into place, Shirayuki’s happily ever after is put on hold. After word of a mysterious boy searching for a girl with apple-red hair reaches the castle, Shirayuki is swept into a harrowing journey that will put her face to face with her past as she tries to determine what her future holds.

seasons.title: Last Period: the journey to the end of the despair
seasons.description: A failed recruit and his new allies face demonic Spirals, fighting for a world's last hope.

seasons.title: Holmes of Kyoto
seasons.description: Holmes, a young man whose family runs an antique shop in Kyoto, has the unique ability to read people and instantly distinguish genuine and high value antiques.
