When they’re not fighting to maintain balance between the living and spirit worlds, how do they spend their time? Join Hanako-kun and Nene on their adventures after school!

seasons.title: Precure Splash Star
seasons.description: During the summer festival, two young girls meet at a mysterious tree. Five years later, Mai, now an aspiring artist, and Saki, ace pitcher on the school softball team, reunite at the same tree. This time, they encounter two fairies seeking help to defeat the evil Dark Fall. To save their worlds, the fairies grant Mai and Saki the power to transform into the legendary warriors, Pretty Cure.

seasons.title: TOUKEN RANBU KAI KYODEN
seasons.description: In 2205 A.D., evil forces attack the past, threatening to alter the course of history. The judge calls on four swordsmen, with blades blessed by a Shinto priest, to protect the past and save the future. Loyal to their former master, the demon king Oda Nobunaga, they travel back to the Honnoji Temple where he was murdered. Can they stop evil in its tracks and preserve the past? Only time will tell.

seasons.title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
seasons.description: Haruaki Abe is happy to finally fulfill his dream of becoming a teacher. That happiness is short-lived after he arrives at Hyakki Academy and finds out the school is full of monsters! Can Abe overcome his cowardice and get his supernatural students under control? Join the timid teacher and his bizarre class for a tale of ghoulish mischief and paranormal education.

seasons.title: A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics
seasons.description: Sosuke Kaburaya is a detective struggling to make ends meet. While on a case, he happens upon Sara da Odin, a princess from another world who wields magical powers. Sara quickly adjusts to modern Japanese life as Livia de Udis, a knight from Sara’s kingdom, arrives to find her. Soon enough, both Sara and Livia’s positivity begins to rub off on Sosuke and the neighborhood’s cast of characters.

seasons.title: Ramen Akaneko
seasons.description: Welcome to Ramen Akaneko, a restaurant run solely by cats. That is, until a human named Tamako Yashiro interviews for a job. Oddly enough, her candor about being a dog person lands her the job. This is a beautiful story of human and feline relationships woven through the many customers who visit Ramen Akaneko. Get ready for an extra helping of heartfelt moments that warm the body and soul.
keywords: 2020s, ramen, cat, workplace, restaurant, feline, job, career, anthropomorphic, cooking

seasons.title: 86 EIGHTY-SIX
seasons.description: Unmanned combat drones, aka Juggernauts, are anything but unmanned. They’re piloted by the Eighty-Six—humans forced to be tools of war. Now given command of the Spearhead Squadron, Lena is seeing the humanity behind those who defend the republic.

seasons.title: RUMBLE GARANNDOLL
seasons.description: Conquered by alternate-world invaders, Japan has become a shadow of what it once was. Manga, anime, idols, and more are censored by these parallel universe overlords...or so it seems. In the less-than-legal stores of Akihabara, Hosomichi joins a group of female freedom fighters made up of pilots and otakus.

seasons.title: Nekopara
seasons.description: Six cute catgirls (or Nekos) work together at a confection shop run by Kashou Minaduki. From baking to running errands, they love to help their human owners out. But a chance encounter with a tiny kitten is about to change everything…

seasons.title: Black Summoner
seasons.description: Kelvin finds himself reincarnated into another world—with a lovestruck goddess, Melfina, as his servant and guide. He no longer has memories from his previous life—because he’s traded them for the advanced magic skills of a Summoner. But not so fast—first he must start his exciting new life as a common adventurer to avoid drawing too much attention to himself…for the time being!

seasons.title: Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac - Battle for Sanctuary
seasons.description: Struck by a gold arrow, the goddess Athena lies dying. Seiya and the Bronze Knights have mere hours to make the perilous climb up Sanctuary and through the Twelve Houses of the Zodiac if they’re to save her life. But blocking their path are the Gold Knights, whose mastery of the Cosmo is legendary. Outclassed and out of time, the Bronze Knights will need a miracle to save Athena and the world!

seasons.title: Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac - Battle for Sanctuary
seasons.description: Struck by a gold arrow, the goddess Athena lies dying. Seiya and the Bronze Knights have mere hours to make the perilous climb up Sanctuary and through the Twelve Houses of the Zodiac if they’re to save her life. But blocking their path are the Gold Knights, whose mastery of the Cosmo is legendary. Outclassed and out of time, the Bronze Knights will need a miracle to save Athena and the world!

seasons.title: RWBY: Ice Queendom
seasons.description: Ruby, Weiss, Blake, and Yang are the next generation of huntresses known as team RWBY. These would-be warriors are learning to defeat the Grimm, but a new nightmare halts their studies. Now, to save a friend, team RWBY must dive into this deadly dream.

seasons.title: Shoot! Goal to the Future
seasons.description: Years after winning a National Championship for Kakegawa High School, Atsushi Kamiya returns as a coach to a less-than-stellar team. And one of the team’s best players, Hideto Tsuji, is over playing soccer altogether! Will the star of a famous soccer team turned coach be able to reinvigorate his team and Hideto?

seasons.title: Lapis Re:LiGHTs
seasons.description: Tiara has just been accepted to the Flora Girls Academy for young witches. Her lifelong dream of becoming a powerful “light” to cleanse the world of magical beasts is now possible. But not before she hits the magical music books! Oh, and little did Tiara know that she’s about to take center stage in a classroom full of potential dropouts. Challenge accepted.

seasons.title: ORIENT
seasons.description: Musashi and Kojiro dream of forming the strongest Bushi band. When oni attack, Musashi must rise up and fight.

seasons.title: Muv-Luv Alternative
seasons.description: A story of the bonds between those who fight, in a world pushed to its limits. On one of the countless parallel worlds that exist throughout spacetime, humanity has fought a decades long war against the BETA, hostile extraterrestrial invaders, using humanoid fighting machines called Tactical Surface Fighters. This is a story of how humanity lives and dies while on the brink of extinction...

seasons.title: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
seasons.description: Living inside a fairy tale may sound like a dream, but for this heroine, it’s more of a nightmare. After her mysterious death, Rinko is reborn as Raeliana—a loved and wealthy character in a novel. But she knows the ending: her murder at the hands of her fiancé. So, she hatches a plan to stay alive, one that involves a devilish duke and a phony engagement. Can she rewrite her story?

seasons.title: MUTEKING THE Dancing HERO
seasons.description: Anything can happen in Neo San Francisco: monster attacks, retro-future tech, killer beats! When there’s monsters, DJ hits play and Muteki becomes Muteking. The invaders can’t keep up when he hits the dance floor. The classic anime retakes the stage!

seasons.title: The Aristocrat's Otherworldly Adventure: Serving Gods Who Go Too Far
seasons.description: Shiina Kazuya’s convenience store visit was anything but when he was killed protecting a girl. He suddenly awakens in the kind of world he has only dreamed about, one with magic and swords! Now as Cain von Silford, a son of an aristocratic family, the gods grant him divine blessings and extraordinary stats. Though he does his best, he still gets in trouble. Cain’s chaotic life is about to begin!

seasons.title: Chainsaw Man
seasons.description: Denji is a poor teenager with a simple dream—to live a happy life with a girl he likes. A far cry from the reality since he’s dirt broke due to his father’s debt. To earn a few bucks, Denji’s forced to hunt down devils with his pet devil Pochita until he’s betrayed and killed. As his consciousness fades, Pochita merges with his dead body and grants him the power of a man with a devil’s heart!

seasons.title: Chainsaw Man - The Compilation
seasons.description: Denji is a young boy who works as a Devil Hunter with the “Chainsaw Devil” Pochita. One day, as he was living his miserable life trying to pay off the debt he inherited from his parents, he got betrayed and killed. As he was losing his consciousness, he made a deal with Pochita, and got resurrected as the “Chainsaw Man”: the owner of the Devil’s heart.

seasons.title: The tale of outcasts
seasons.description: In Victorian England, the young orphan Wisteria begs for scraps. Able to see through demons’ disguises, she befriends the immortal Marbas, lonely after centuries of solitude. He finds kinship with the human girl, even while evading the brutal Sword Cross Knights—including Wisteria’s brother. Is it possible for two souls so different to find happiness together, and what price must they pay?

seasons.title: GLOOMY THE NAUGHTY GRIZZLY
seasons.description: GLOOMY is Pity’s pet bear. He’s a little over 6 feet and weighs as much as 2000 pomegranates. He’s well trained for the most part, but he can never remember that he’s not supposed to attack humans. Still, a pet owner must take ultimate responsibility for his pets. Recalling warm memories of GLOOMY as a cute bear cub, Pity tries to lead a life of peaceful co-existence with his pet bear.

seasons.title: Deaimon: Recipe for Happiness
seasons.description: Upon hearing that his father has been hospitalized, Nagomu‚ the prodigal son of a family owning a sweet shop in Kyoto‚ returns home after 10 years to take over the family business. Nagomu is eager to do it, but he is instead asked to be a father figure to Itsuka, a girl who started working at the shop while he was gone and whom everyone now calls the successor.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Embroiled in a hundred-year war, young Iska is sent to assassinate the Ice Calamity Witch, Aliceliese. Meant to murder each other, their initial encounter on the battleground creates doubt in their missions, but finding common ground together would make them traitors to their own countries. Though circumstances previously made them enemies, their now conflicted hearts may just make them lovers!

seasons.title: ABCiee Working Diary
seasons.description: ABCiee tackles his dream TV job with humor and heart, facing quirky coworkers and unexpected challenges.

seasons.title: Fafner
seasons.description: Before an aggressive alien race suddenly attacked their quiet, isolated island, Kazuki and his friends knew only a life of peace. Now the people of the island look to the teenagers as their last hope for survival. As the only ones capable of controlling highly-sophisticated secret weapons—the Fafner—these young pilots fight desperately to protect their loved ones, as well as their own identities.

seasons.title: Fafner The Beyond
seasons.description: Humanity’s war with the Festum, an aggressive race of extraterrestrials, rages on. While there’s no end to the conflict in sight, young pilots continue the fight for their island. They operate the Fafner, a sophisticated weapon used to defend the people of Ryugujima. Soshi struggles with his humanity and the battles that lie ahead. Is victory a fleeting possibility? They must fight to find out.

seasons.title: Gekidol
seasons.description: Five years after a mystifying disaster decimates cities across the globe, Seria Morino receives an invitation from a mysterious woman to join Alice in Theater, a small stage troupe that takes it upon themselves to brighten the world through their performances using 3D hologram technology. As Seria settles in, she begins to uncover unexpected truths about herself and the world around her...

seasons.title: Actors: Song Connection
seasons.description: A VOCALOID x voice actors collaboration, featuring songs from EXIT TUNES. Within a sprawling academic metropolis lies an exclusive academy where students are encouraged to join clubs such as singing and archaeology to earn points for recognition. The most important of these is the big singing contest where all contestants have to sing in front of the entire school!

seasons.title: The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague
seasons.description: For Himuro, being a descendant of a snow spirit is tough at the workplace when your emotions can lead to snow blasts with snowmen and igloos. Any emotionally charged incident with coworkers can trigger it—conflict, fun, and in this case, romance. And with his lovely and calm coworker Fuyutsuki, he gets more frozen, literally. Get ready for a snow-white office romance that blows in like a blizzard.

seasons.title: NIJIYON ANIMATION 1
seasons.description: Nijigasaki High School Idol Club is on the verge of being disbanded! It’s up to the club’s 13 members to come together to stop this. Based on the spinoff to Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club comes a slice of life anime following 13 Nijigasaki girls’ cute lives filled with drama, suspense, and excitement!

seasons.title: NIJIYON ANIMATION 2
seasons.description: The Nijigasaki High School Idol Club is back with more excitement, drama, and fun. A new year at Nijigasaki High School means new students, and we’ll know soon enough who’s ready to join the school idol club. Familiar faces return, including Karin Asaka, Kanata Konoe, Shioriko Mifune, Ai Miyashita, Kasumi Nakusu, Shizuku Osaka, and more, for what will be another unforgettable year.

seasons.title: Rokudo's Bad Girls
seasons.description: Rokudo’s miserable days of being picked on have taken a major turn with a new ability that’s made him the target of every delinquent girl’s affection. The source? A mysterious scroll from his late grandfather, an unusual inheritance to say the least. Now he’s in a romantic panic full of nonstop madness with every bad girl he comes in contact with. Will he ever catch a break?

seasons.title: VAZZROCK THE ANIMATION
seasons.description: Twelve dazzling talents decide to make the most daring music groups ever: VAZZY and ROCK DOWN. Through rivalry and friendship, these gems help each other get better in every way. Even with unique differences, they all share a common goal—to shine!

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Reincarnated as an immortal witch, Azusa enjoyed 300 years of peace. Now at level 99, adventure comes calling!

seasons.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level Season 2
BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia I: Promise
seasons.description: "Are you prepared to fully devote yourselves to Roselia?” To reach the stage of “FES.“, Yukina Minato decides to form a band. Each holding their own convictions, the members of the band come together. The five girls now begin their journey to the top as Roselia... This is the story of their “promise” made to each other, from the start of the band to their challenge towards FUTURE WORLD FES!

seasons.title: BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia II: Song I am
seasons.description: Roselia chases their dreams, overcoming tribulations to perform at FUTURE WORLD FES.

seasons.title: Poppin' Dream!
seasons.description: Poppin'Party rushes to make their overseas festival debut, facing unexpected challenges along the way.

seasons.title: Film Live 2nd Stage
seasons.description: Performing together, can Pastel✽Palettes and Poppin'Party overcome their nerves and create a dream ensemble?

seasons.title: Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation
seasons.description: In a magic academy, a group of girls known as Pentagrams pursue their studies and train in manners and magic to become “true ladies.” Meet Arsnotoria and her dormmates: life-of-the-party Mel, quiet Petit Albert, class-president-wannabe Picatrix, and always-cool Abramelin. Taking classes, doing their school duties, throwing tea parties—we’ll share the girls’ fun and lively days with you!

seasons.title: Sasaki and Miyano
seasons.description: Miyano spends his days reading Boys’ Love manga and worrying about the soft features of his face. His world of fiction becomes reality when a chance encounter leads him to high school senior Sasaki in the middle of a fight. Now, Sasaki wants to spend every opportunity he can to get to know Miyano. And what was once admiration quickly turns into affection.

seasons.title: Sasaki and Miyano: Graduation
seasons.description: On the cusp of graduation, Sasaki and Miyano face new feelings in their blossoming relationship.
seasons.availability_notes: test

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Humanity survives with the help of androids known as Dolls. Built to serve, some fight in wars as Tactical Dolls or T-Dolls. Now, an elite team of T-Dolls and their newly assigned human commander M4A1 are sent to face a new rogue threat, Sangvis Ferri.

seasons.title: Idol Time Pripara
seasons.description: Yui dreams of being an idol. PriPara opens in Paparajuku, but a glitch threatens her big chance.

seasons.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window
seasons.description: Mikado, a bookstore clerk who sees ghosts, teams up with an exorcist to solve chilling mysteries.

seasons.title: Let Me Check The Walkthrough First
seasons.description: Lin Yinuo is a 30-year-old office worker with a passion for gaming. One day, she is accidentally summoned to a virtual game world. In order to make it back to her own reality, she must train the game's young hero, Tian Enya. Together, they’ll learn, grow, and play through the game’s many levels. Joined by new friends, nothing can stand in their way!

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Welcome to Maebashi City, Gunma Prefecture. For first-year high school student Yuina Akagi, her middling life takes a wild turn the moment a mysterious frog named Keroppe shows up and asks her, “Why don’t you become a witch?” Alongside Azu Niisato, Kyoka Kitahara, Choco Mitsumata, and Mai Kamiizumi, Yuina and her friends are excited to make people’s dreams come true as the Maebashi Witches.

seasons.title: Meiji Gekken: 1874
seasons.description: By 1874, seven years have passed since the end of the samurai era. A former samurai, Shizuma Orikasa works as a rickshaw driver in Tokyo while looking for his fiancée, Sumie Kanomata, who went missing during the Boshin War. Shizuma thwarts an assassination attempt and joins the newly established police department, where he’ll fight to stop dark forces from overthrowing the government.

seasons.title: A Girl and Her Guard Dog
seasons.description: Isaku, the granddaughter of a yakuza boss, just wants a normal life. So, she enrolls in a high school far away in hopes of a fresh start. But her plans take an unexpected turn when a worried yakuza member, Keiya, enrolls in the same school to protect her.

seasons.title: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again
seasons.description: After eating a mysterious apple from their farm, an elderly pair of lovebirds, Shouzou and Ine, experience a miraculous transformation into their younger selves. Despite their newfound youth and beauty, the two continue in their cute senior ways. Witness an enduring bond that’s stronger and more precious than ever before.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: On a rainy day, Fuji meets a cute critter posing as a dog and offering an umbrella and a cue card that says, “Please take me home,” and she can’t resist. With this dog-poster’s quirky charm and mysterious ways, life together becomes a heartwarming adventure of friendship and shared seasons.

seasons.title: Acro Trip
seasons.description: Chizuko is a normal otaku girl in Niigata Prefecture. She’s obsessed with Berry Blossom, a magical heroine who protects the city. But the battles with her inept nemesis, Chroma, have become so lackluster that they’re not even worth watching. Chizuko wants to see Berry’s full power, a desire that quickly leads this seemingly timid girl down a path of evil.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: In a world where magic reigns, Will Serfort can’t cast a spell. Though hardworking, Will’s classmates think less of him for it. However, he has a secret strength: his sword. Can Will defy expectations with muscle over magic and blade over wand? Find out in this epic sword-and-sorcery adventure!

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: In a world where magic reigns, Will Serfort can’t cast a spell. Though hardworking, Will’s classmates think less of him for it. However, he has a secret strength: his sword. Can Will defy expectations with muscle over magic and blade over wand? Find out in this epic sword-and-sorcery adventure!

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: For Makoto Hanaoka, life’s about to get more complicated. Saki Aoi, a lively girl with loads of confidence, confesses her love for Makoto one day. When he fails to reciprocate, Saki declares she will be his first love! She shares her goal with a mutual friend, Ryuji Taiga, who also confesses his crush on Makoto. Stuck in a love triangle, Makoto must find a way to make it work and have fun.

seasons.title: Senpai is an Otokonoko Movie : Sunshine After the Rain
seasons.description: It’s been nearly a year since Makoto Hanaoka, Saki Aoi, and Ryuji Taiga met, and each of them now face their own issues. Makoto can’t seem to keep Saki off his mind, though she’s off to Hawaii to meet her father, Yuji. Unexpectedly, Yuji asks Saki to live there with him. As Saki contemplates the changes a move would bring, Makoto and Ryuji have to make choices of their own regarding their futures.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Scarlet has put up with her fiancé’s bullying long enough. Not only is Second Prince Kyle arrogant and crude, but he suddenly called off their engagement during a ball. And if things couldn’t get any worse, he then accuses her of a crime she never committed. Fueled by betrayal, Scarlet unleashes her rage, giving the prince and his nobles a beatdown they’ll never forget.

seasons.title: Grisaia Phantom Trigger
seasons.description: After the Heath Oslo incident exposed the U.S.-Japanese anti-terror organization CIRS, a new agency emerges to train elite operatives: SORD. Mihama Academy, once abandoned, is now part of a series of SORD training grounds for misfit girls to hone their deadly skills. Armed with live ammunition, they face perilous missions, sacrificing their safety for the country’s future.

seasons.title: The Unwanted Undead Adventurer
seasons.description: Rentt Faina has hunted monsters for the last 10 years. Sadly, he’s not great at his job, stuck hunting slimes and goblins for a few coins each day. His luck turns when he finds an undiscovered path. At the path’s end, he meets his demise in the maw of a legendary dragon. But, he wakes up as an undead bag of bones! He sets out to achieve Existential Evolution and rejoin the land of the living.

seasons.title: WONDER EGG PRIORITY
seasons.description: This is the story of Ai, an introverted girl whose fate is forever changed when she acquires a mysterious “Wonder Egg” from a deserted arcade. That night, her dreams blend into reality, and as other girls obtain their own Wonder Eggs, Ai discovers new friends—and the magic within herself.

seasons.title: Bungo and Alchemist -Gears of Judgement-
seasons.description: From studio OLM, known for the Pokémon series, the original Berserk anime, and Ni no Kuni, comes a brand-new show based on the popular mobile game of the same name. Bungo and Alchemist -Gears of Judgement- is set in a fantasy world with famous and handsome historical figures from the field of literature who must call upon their magical abilities to save books that have been tainted by evil forces.

seasons.title: Demon Lord, Retry!
seasons.description: Akira Oono solemnly prepares to shut down the servers to his favorite creation, Infinity Game. Suddenly, he awakens within the game as one of his favorite characters, Hakuto Kunai. His life as a Demon Lord comes with unique powers and abilities, as well as a target on his back. He’ll travel the lands, make friends, and fight enemies on his quest to understand why he was summoned to the game.

seasons.title: Demon Lord, Retry! R
seasons.description: Akira Oono finds himself in the world of Infinity Game as the last boss and his favorite character, the Demon Lord Hakuto Kunai. After meeting Aku, Luna, and other friends along the way, the Demon Lord begins a new journey to find a spell that can take him back to the real world. The story of the Demon Lord continues in this next chapter!

seasons.title: Healer Girl
seasons.description: The world can be healed through music, and these three girls want to make it happen. Meet Kana Fujii, Reimi Itsushiro, and Hibiki Morishima—three healers-in-training at the Karasuma Phoniatric Clinic learning the art of healing patients’ illnesses and injuries by singing. Join them on this musical adventure of kindhearted, powerful miracles sung to heal the world.

seasons.title: Fate/Grand Carnival
seasons.description: Servants gather at Chaldea, facing resource struggles and hidden tensions.

seasons.title: Stars Align
seasons.description: Toma Shinjo has a dilemma: he wants to save his school’s soft tennis club before it’s shut down! He seeks the help of Maki Katsuragi, a reluctant student with natural talent and other priorities. It’s going to be their last summer together as a team unless they all find a way to work together to save the club!

seasons.title: If My Favorite Pop Idol Made It to the Budokan, I Would Die
seasons.description: Eripiyo is a normal girl with a passion for music—specifically the idol group ChamJam. After seeing one of their performances, Eripiyo makes it her goal to help the group make it to the big stage at Budokan, in any way she can. She frequently attends their concerts with her friends, Kumasa and Motoi. No one said being a superfan was easy, but for Eripiyo, nothing is more worth it.

seasons.title: A Couple of Cuckoos
seasons.description: On the way to meet his birth parents, super-student Nagi meets brash Erika, who needs a quick favor. Pose as her boyfriend at dinner so she can avoid an arranged marriage. But things get tricky once they realize they‚Äôre heading to the same spot, and her parents still want them wed. How does he ask out his school crush, keep his grades up, and hide his pending nuptials? No one said love was easy!

seasons.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season2
seasons.description: Umino Nagi and Amano Erika were born on the same day and swapped at birth. Nagi was raised as the son of a diner owner, and Erika the daughter of a hotel tycoon. Their parents encourage them to become engaged, and they begin life together. Soon though, infatuations arise as Nagi becomes stuck in a love quadrangle. Life and love are embroiled in epic turmoil as fate is set in motion once again!

seasons.title: TAMAYOMI: The Baseball Girls
seasons.description: Even with her “miracle ball,” junior high student Yomi Takeda’s pitching career ended in heartbreak. When she reunites with childhood friend Tamaki Yamazaki in high school, the only person who could catch her signature pitch, it rekindles her passion to play. To fulfill the promise made to each other as kids, she’s eager to step up to the plate again.

seasons.title: D_CIDE TRAUMEREI THE ANIMATION
seasons.description: Ryuhei's world changes after a mysterious bite, unraveling dark desires and hidden dangers in Shibuya.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one’s identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one’s identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: The hero Toto has talent, but his shyness has prevented him from forming a party. As he languishes in the town of origins, three beautiful women—Ciel, Anemone, and Goa—invite Toto to join their party out of the blue. Toto gears up to begin the journey, but unbeknownst to him, all three women are plotting to kill him for their own reasons!

seasons.title: The Family Circumstances of the Irregular Witch
seasons.description: When witch Alyssa found a baby on her doorstep, she didn’t expect her life to take a topsy-turvy turn. Despite her bewilderment, she names the child Viola and decides to raise her. Fast-forward 16 years, and her “daughter” Viola isn’t just taller—she’s towering! Join this bewitching duo in a hilariously chaotic journey of mistaken identities and supernatural shenanigans!

seasons.title: Liar, Liar
seasons.description: A mind game of lies and deceit begins! At Academy Island, students battle in Games to win stars, hoping to earn the prestigious title “Seven Star.” Sarasa is last year’s champion and is on track to win again until Hiroto, a new transfer student, hits the scene. Surprisingly, Hiroto defeats her by sheer luck! Now, he must use bluffs and trickery to stay on top.

seasons.title: Super Dimension Century Orguss
seasons.description: In the year 2026, ace fighter pilot Kei Katuragi is transported to a dystopian future when the space/time oscillation bomb detonates during a failed mission. As the militant group called Chilam seek to hunt him down in an unfamiliar land, Kei must fight his way back to the past aboard his mecha Orguss along with some help from a mystical band of gypsies called Emaan.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Following the collapse of civilization, one storied hotel stands among the ruins of Tokyo’s Ginza district. Overrun by nature, this lone hotel continues to defy humanity’s collapse. Current guests: zero. Check-ins scheduled today: zero. Yesterday’s website traffic: zero. Enter with caution in this story of survival and mystery in a world where the memory of humanity begins to fade.

seasons.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World
seasons.description: Pulled into an otherworldly adventure with cute sidekicks and superpowers, you’d think Osamu hit the jackpot. Nope! From a time before pixels, the early 20th-century gloomy author just wants to find a quiet place to meet his maker, not to rack up XP. Sadly, his poetic demise is constantly thwarted by inconvenient heroics. Dive into the hilariously tragic life of the most reluctant hero!

seasons.title: Power of Hope ~Precure Full Bloom~
seasons.description: Nozomi Yumehara was an ordinary middle school student until she met the mysterious fairy Coco. She became the Precure of Hope, Cure Dream, and fought alongside her friends. Years later, Nozomi and her friends are now adults, busy with work, friends, family, and the stress that adult life brings. As the mysterious Shadows appear and attack humans, Nozomi and her friends embark on a new saga.

seasons.title: Season 01
seasons.description: At Letran Magic Academy, two unlikely friends share one dream: to become magicians. Kurumi is an average girl who’s a bit naive, while Yuzu is the distinguished daughter of a noble magician family. They need to get into a special magician training class, but they fail the entrance exam! All hope seems lost until mysterious homeroom teacher Minami Suzuki arrives, and their luck takes a sudden turn.

seasons.title: Oblivion Battery
seasons.description: Star pitcher Haruka Kiyomine and skilled catcher Kei Kaname were an unstoppable duo—until Kei was hit with a curveball: amnesia. Now they have a second chance to play at a no-name high school with a team of past rivals. Can they overcome Kei’s memory loss and rekindle their baseball dreams? With hilarious hijinks and fierce competition, get ready for a strikeout.

seasons.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
seasons.description: Normally, people choose to become adventurers in their teens. At 30 years old, Rick Gladiatol bucks the trend by leaving his job as a guild clerk to become an adventurer. He begins as a novice F-rank with the fighting strength of an S-rank. After two years of brutal training with the continent’s strongest party, Orichalcum Fist, Rick will defeat anyone who underestimates him!

seasons.title: BONES 25: DREAMING FORWARD
seasons.description: Embark on a captivating journey through the illustrious legacy of Studio BONES, celebrating 25 years of groundbreaking animation. In Crunchyroll’s exclusive four-part documentary, hear from 37 legendary industry insiders on the studio’s evolution. Narrated by Junichi Suwabe, explore BONES’ storied past, history, and future aspirations.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: In a seemingly ordinary rural town, something strange is happening to the residents. But Shizuru Chikura is more concerned for her missing friend. Determined to find her, Shizuru and three other girls board an abandoned train and travel to the outside world, unsure if they’ll make it back alive. As they venture toward the unknown, the question looms: What awaits them at the final stop?

seasons.title: AYAKA
seasons.description: As an orphan, Yukito Yanagi’s life is filled with questions, but that all changed when he meets his father’s disciple who takes him to his birthplace on Ayaka. A strange island filled with legends of dragons and mysterious beings. But there’s more to this trip than a reunion—the harmony of Ayaka is on the brink of collapsing into chaos. Can Yukito prevent this catastrophe?

seasons.title: Mr. Villain's Day Off
seasons.description: The General is a leader of a villainous organization that plans to take over the world. He spends his time fighting against the Rangers, who have sworn to protect the Earth. But today, it's the General's day off. He loves going to the zoo to see the pandas and to the store to get some ice cream. Join the infamous villain as he attempts to enjoy his free time in a comedy that heals the soul.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Humans fight to protect their land from invading demi-human tribes in relentless battles. As his world is engulfed by intense warfare, Kai, a village boy from Lag, joins the fight to defend all he knows. After Kai’s comrades fall one by one and he’s injured, he suddenly recalls memories from another life. A fantasy tale unfolds as a village boy explores a world of magic, mystery, and heroism.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: She’s small. She’s sweet. She’s…capable of obliterating a tank in under three seconds?! Built by Enji and Suzume, two underappreciated genius scientists, Alma is the ultimate self-learning AI. There’s just one thing: She thinks they’re her mom and dad! Now as unexpected co-parents, the duo must hide their budding romantic feelings while taking on the messiest experiment of all: family life!

seasons.title: Tokyo Magnitude 8.0
seasons.description: Tokyo Magnitude 8.0

seasons.title: Backflip!!
seasons.description: In the final summer of middle school, Shotaro Futaba stumbles upon a men’s rhythmic gymnastics tournament and is completely enamored by it. He goes to Soshukan Private High School, where he joins the rhythmic gymnastics club along with star gymnast Ryoya Misato. The boys must come together as a team to reach their common goal. Each laugh takes them higher. Each tear makes them stronger.

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress
seasons.description: Stand up, Vanguard! A new story in the Vanguard series awaits! Planet Cray enters a new era of lore and fighters. Unable to cope with his unique heart-reading abilities, middle schooler Yu-yu Kondo flees home where he encounters Vanguard in action. His journey leads to a new world of lore, cardfights, and friendships. Prepare for a new generation of cardfighters!

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress
seasons.description: Yu-yu Kondo loses to Tohya Ebata, and the banner that symbolizes Team Blackout goes up in ashes. And while Yu-yu and his friends are still stunned by this turn of events, their leader Danji Momoyama returns and challenges Tohya to a Vanguard fight, a fight that ends in a clear victory for Danji. As the group starts to shower Tohya with a deluge of jeers, Danji announces his departure from the...

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress
seasons.description: Yu-yu Kondo, unable to refuse requests, flees home and finds refuge in Wonder Hill, a haven for Vanguard fans.

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress Season 2
seasons.description: Yu-yu Kondo, unable to refuse requests, flees home and finds refuge in Wonder Hill, a haven for Vanguard fans.

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress Season 3
seasons.description: Using high-level plays by strong fighters as its base, the “UNI app” allows beginners to quickly improve their skills and has brought about a drastic change in how Vanguard is played. Cementing its place as a dream program with global appeal, Vanguard has become dominated by the Uniformers. Meanwhile… Masanori schemes in the shadows. The mysterious Shirogane has a string of tournament...

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez
seasons.description: Akina Myodo’s ill sister doesn’t have much time, but a glimmer of hope to cure her emerges. To make his wish come true, Akina has been selected in Fated Clash, where six fighters battle to collect the Six Desires—cards with the power to change fate. But only the last one standing will have their wish granted. Can Akina grab ahold of this miracle and change fate?

seasons.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez Season 2
seasons.description: Akina has claimed victory at Vanguard’s Fated Clash and restored his sister’s health. While he spends time with her at home, Gabwelius calls on the holders of the Fated One Cards and reveals the true purpose of the Fated Clash. But then, a new creature named Sybilt appears, who declares the start of the Destined Showdown, where triumph guarantees any wish granted.

seasons.title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
seasons.description: A salaryman, after a rejection, takes in a high school runaway, forming an awkward, heartwarming bond.

seasons.title: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
seasons.description: Hitori Gotoh, aka Bocchi-chan, plays guitar in hopes of joining a band. And while she’s famous online, what’s holding her back is that she’s incredibly introverted. That is, until a desperate drummer gets Bocchi-chan out of her shell and onto the stage.

seasons.title: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam
seasons.description: Char Aznable, as Quattro Bajeena, infiltrates Gryps to expose the Titans' new Gundam project.

seasons.title: TRIGUN STAMPEDE
seasons.description: Vash the Stampede is a wanted man with a habit of turning towns into rubble across the arid wastelands of a desert planet. The price on his head is a fortune! Yet, there’s no proof that he’s ever taken a life. In fact, he’s a pacifist with a doughnut obsession who’s more doofus than desperado. There’s more to him than his reputation lets on—Vash the Stampede definitely ain’t your typical outlaw.

seasons.title: TRIGUN STARGAZE
seasons.description: Two and a half years after the Lost JuLai tragedy, journalist Meryl continues her search for Vash with her new partner, Milly. Living in hiding as Eriks, Vash is driven back into the open by a desperate SOS and the renewed movement of Millions Knives’s forces. When a fleet of colony ships from Earth offers humanity a chance to escape, hope spreads…until an old enemy returns to crush it.

seasons.title: Selection Project
seasons.description: Suzune Miyama has been sick since childhood, but always used idol Akari Amasawa’s music for courage and smiles through hard times. Now in her final year of junior high, Suzune is auditioning against thousands of contestants to become one of nine chosen idols in the “Selection Project”—the exact audition competition Akari used to gain fame. Will she follow in her icon’s footsteps?

seasons.title: A Galaxy Next Door
seasons.description: After his father’s death, Ichiro is left to care for his siblings alone. They’re barely scraping by with only a small inheritance and his job as a manga artist, which isn’t going so great. That is until a talented and beautiful assistant is hired! Her name is Shiori, and she’s a gift from above—literally. While working late one night, her true identity is revealed and they’re instantly engaged!?

seasons.title: Magi: The Kingdom of Magic
seasons.description: The story follows the travels of a boy named Aladdin around a strange land in which mysterious ruins called Dungeons are said to house priceless treasures. Together with Alibaba, a friend he met during his travels, Aladdin strives to conquer all of the Dungeons and obtain their treasures. Through all the meetings and partings he experiences along the way, Aladdin will also learn of his own fate...

seasons.title: Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken!
seasons.description: High schoolers Midori, Sayaka, and Tsubame form an animation club to bring their wildest ideas to life.

seasons.title: Disgaea
seasons.description: Laharl, the demon prince of the Netherworld and son of the late Lord Krichevskoy, is awakened by Flonne, the sugary-sweet angel-in-training sent to assassinate the overlord. Etna, the Prinnies, and Flonne, join the selfish, disgruntled, and perpetually hungry Laharl as he treks the deepest, darkest realms to become king of the cursed land.

seasons.title: Pastel Memories
seasons.description: Akihabara is known as a shining beacon for otaku culture everywhere. But in a not-to-distant future, that culture is on the decline due to a mysterious affliction causing widespread memory loss. As a result, Akihabara has lost its luster. However, in one of the few remaining otaku shops, Izumi and a handful of comrades hatch a plan to restore lost memories and return “Akiba” to its former glory.

seasons.title: Mob Psycho 100
seasons.description: Kageyama Shigeo (a.k.a. Mob) is an 8th grader with powerful psychic abilities. Working under his not-so-capable master, Reigen, Mob uses his powers to exorcise evil spirits. But his will to be normal causes him to suppress his powers and feelings until he hits 100 percent—a point where his pent-up emotions are unleased and a darker power takes over.

seasons.title: Mob Psycho 100 II
seasons.description: He may have defeated Claw, but psychic extraordinaire and socially awkward middle schooler Mob still has important questions on his mind. Is Reigen exploiting his abilities? Could anyone stop him if he went totally berserk? Does Tsubomi like him? With more and more friends at his side, he should be alright. So long as he learns to think for himself.

seasons.title: Mob Psycho 100 III
seasons.description: In the wake of Mob’s psychic battle, a giant broccoli remains. Worshipped by the Psycho Helmet religion, the Divine Tree has begun to affect everyone—including Mob’s friends. Will he face the threat looming in the shade, or should he just enjoy life?

seasons.title: Kiitaro's yokai picture diary
seasons.description: Kiitaro's life changes when he's forced to move, meeting a zashiki warashi and other friendly spirits.

seasons.title: Chio's School Road
seasons.description: Think about everything that could possibly go wrong on an awkward girl’s way to school. Now escalate it quickly, and you’ve got Chio’s life. She’ll dive into trash to avoid confrontation, or pose as an assassin because that’s literally the only way to explain knocking over a thug’s motorcycle. But does she ever make it to school on time? Who knows.

seasons.title: KING OF PRISM -Shiny Seven Stars-
seasons.description: Shin enters high school, while rivals vie for the Prism King title.

seasons.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
seasons.description: Anos, the reincarnated Demon King, faces weak descendants and must prove his power at the Demon King Academy.

seasons.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy II: History's Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants
seasons.description: With Lay’s might, Anos destroys the insane human Jerga. Universal peace now within reach, he reveals his true identity to Delsgade Academy. As everyone processes this news, a deadly spectre from his past schemes to obliterate him—someone closer than he realizes. But soon, teacher and student will be taught a lesson 2,000 years in the making—you cross the Demon King of Tyranny at your own peril!

seasons.title: Gad Guard
seasons.description: Hajiki’s struggling to get by on the streets of Night Town, where everyone’s fighting for the same thing: the Gad. If you’ve got a Gad, you’ve got the power of a robotic Techode at your disposal. And if you’ve got a Techode—you’ve got a chance. Hajiki’s about to find out just how much life can change when machine and man form an incredible bond.

seasons.title: Upotte!!
seasons.description: A new teacher finds his students are anthropomorphized guns, adding explosive energy to school life.

seasons.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
seasons.description: The year is 2017 of the Imperial calendar and parts of the world are under the control of the Holy Britannian Empire. Lelouch Lamperouge, an exiled Britannian prince, encounters a strange girl known as C.C., who gifts him with a great and terrible power. The Geass. With this powerful ability, Lelouch can get anyone to do as he wills. But the power of Geass: is it a blessing…or a curse?

seasons.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2
seasons.description: The Holy Brittanian Empire continues its reign over half of the world. A beacon of hope arose with Zero, a masked rebel really named Lelouch Lamperouge, joined by his army of Black Knights. Zero fights a childhood friend, a knight of Brittania named Suzaku Kururugi. A year later, he is declared dead. His Black Knights continue the fight, even as their numbers and hope begin to dwindle.

seasons.title: Tsuredure Children
seasons.description: Short and charming comedic vignettes offer a quick glimpse into the unique and funny situations, misunderstandings, and all around confusion that can happen in a high school romance. For starters, there’s a story about a delinquent girl and the student council president, and one about a stoic boy confused about an emotional girl. Relive the charm of high school romance!

seasons.title: Magical Somera-chan
seasons.description: Somera Nonomoto is the strongest NEET who has inherited the invincible “Nonomoto Mahou-ken” from her late mother. The short anime focuses on the daily life of Somera and the people around her.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: After suffering a humiliating loss at the Grand Prix Final, Japan’s number one skater, Yuri Katsuki, is ready to hang up his skates for good. But when his idol and five-time champion Victor Nikiforov offers to be his coach, Yuri’s put on a trek for gold and to discover the true meaning of victory! Together, they’ll face skaters from around the world.

seasons.title: Dragonaut -THE RESONANCE-
seasons.description: With an asteroid hurtling toward Earth, sexy human Dragonauts and their curvaceous dragon companions unite to create a formidable fighting force. In the middle of this race against time are Jin, a heartbroken flyboy, and Toa—a voluptuous mystery woman. If they can unlock the secrets of their connection and convince the Dragonauts to join the action, there may yet be hope for planet Earth!

seasons.title: Keijo!!!!!!!!
seasons.description: Welcome to the exciting world of Keijo, the new sport craze with girl-on-girl battles between boobs and butts! On the rigorous journey to going pro, 18-year-old Nozomi Kaminashi will train hard with other talented girls at Setouchi Keijo Training School. After getting hip-whipped into shape, it’s time for these ladies to test their skills against the gluteal gladiators of their rival school.

seasons.title: Bananya
seasons.description: What could be cuter than a little kitten? A kitten inside a…banana?! Bananya is a carefree kitty that lives in a banana with dreams of becoming a delicious chocolate-covered dessert. But he’s not the only one in the bunch! He lives with other bananya friends who come out to play when humans aren’t around. Get ready for silly antics and fun adventures!

seasons.title: Bananya and the Curious Bunch
seasons.description: On a nearby tiny planet, a strange new species has just emerged—bananyas! Part cat and part banana, this adorable bunch lives a peaceful life filled with friendship and adventure. But when items from Earth start falling from the sky, they become quite curious about what lies just beyond their world.

seasons.title: Bananya Around the World
seasons.description: Bananya returns! The mysterious cat who lives inside a banana is back for a new adventure when a ball of light appears. After the ball flashes, a new cat named Baby Sweet emerges. The two quickly become friends and set off on a grand adventure to discover new and exciting places around the world. Join the new friends on their journey!

seasons.title: Bananya 10th Anniversary Special
seasons.description: A short about the secret life of kitties who live in bananas!

seasons.title: Wacky TV Nanana Chase the Kraken Monster!
seasons.description: A struggling TV crew fights layoffs by hunting for buried treasure in a desperate, high-stakes new show.

seasons.title: Kenka Bancho Otome -Girl Beats Boys-
seasons.description: Only the toughest of dudes can rise through the ranks at Shishiku Academy, an all-boys school for delinquents. That is, until Hinako—a girl—finds out that she’s from a powerful yakuza family and must attend the school disguised as her twin brother! But as she climbs the ranks to rule the school, will the path be filled with broken bones…or broken hearts?

seasons.description: The Ninterudo Empire and the Segua Kingdom have been locked in a war for supremacy over the land of Consume for many years. The powerful Ninterudo Empire under the leadership of Marcus, with many excellent killers possessing various special abilities, has gained the upper hand in the struggle, occupying the majority of Consume as well as the surrounding nations. The Segua Kingdom has been left with no plausible option but to fight defensively... until the arrival of Gear drastically turns the tides.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Desperate to pay off his family’s debt, Futaro Uesugi quintuples his troubles when he accepts a new job—tutoring a set of quintuplets! If he can’t get Itsuki, Miku, Ichika, Nino, and Yotsuba to hit the books, he can kiss his paycheck goodbye.

seasons.description: Tsubasa starts a girls' baseball club, rallying players to face challenges and support each other.

seasons.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Tanjiro Kamado, Unwavering Resolve Arc
seasons.description: Tanjiro, a kindhearted boy who sells charcoal for a living, finds his family slaughtered by a demon. To make matters worse, his younger sister Nezuko, the sole survivor, was transformed into a demon herself. Though devastated by this grim reality, Tanjiro resolves to join the Demon Slayer Corps, turn his sister back into a human, and kill the demon that massacred his family.

seasons.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train
seasons.description: Falling forever into an endless dream... Tanjiro and the group have completed their rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, and they arrive to their next mission on the Mugen Train, where over 40 people have disappeared in a very short period of time. Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame...

seasons.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc
seasons.description: After their rehabilitation training, Tanjiro and his comrades begin their next mission on the Mugen Train, where over 40 people have disappeared. With one of the most powerful swordsmen, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, they face the nightmare on board.

seasons.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc
seasons.description: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc follows Tanjiro and his friends' next mission after the Mugen Train. Alongside one of the Demon Slayer Corps' top ranked swordsmen, Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui, Tanjiro heads to a place where demons dwell – the Entertainment District.

seasons.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
seasons.description: After his last emotional fight, Tanjiro must pick up the pieces if he’s to move forward. He journeys to the legendary Swordsmith Village with Nezuko in tow. There he encounters Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Hashira, and Mitsuri Kanroji, the Love Hashira. Unbeknownst to everyone, Upper Six Demons are lurking far closer than anyone realizes!

seasons.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc
seasons.description: As the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji looms, the Hashira Training begins. Led by high-ranking swordsmen, Tanjiro and the rest of the young warriors face their grueling training with faith and determination. Together, they enter a new chapter to prepare for their mightiest foe.

seasons.title: A Certain Scientific Accelerator
seasons.description: After rescuing Last Order and subsequently taking a bullet to the head, Academy City’s top-ranked esper rests in the hospital. But Accelerator’s recovery is cut short when a mysterious girl carrying a photo of his little clone companion asks for help.

seasons.title: Scar-red Rider XechS
seasons.description: The Blue World, a world symbolizing reason, is under attack by fierce creatures known as the Nightfly O’Note sent from the Red World, a world symbolizing instinct. Elected to lead the Blue World, 17-year-old researcher Akira Asagi will take charge of the combat unit “IS”. These six riders, also called the Scared Rider Xechs, will fight at the Ryuukyuu LAG to protect their world and each other.

seasons.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
seasons.description: Catarina awakens in a game world, cast as the villain. To avoid grim fates, she must rewrite her future.
seasons.availability_notes: [link url="https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/my-next-life-as-a-villainess-all-routes-lead-to-doom/"]Read the My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! manga, available from Seven Seas Entertainment![/link]

seasons.description: Yuzu Aihara loves fashion, friends, and having fun! But when her mom remarries and she’s forced to transfer schools, this fashionable teen’s sweet life turns sour. On her first day, she makes enemies with the beautiful student council president, Mei, who also winds up being her brand-new stepsister. But nothing can prepare Yuzu for a surprise kiss from this girl who supposedly hates her!

seasons.description: In an imperfect world, the stories make it beautiful. Meet Kino, a traveler exploring beyond the boundaries into unknown mystical places! With only a gun and the talking motorcycle Hermes, Kino learns about unique people and their customs through the fascinating stories they weave. But to see everything, they can only spare three days in each land before moving on to the next adventure.

seasons.description: Konohana Kitan is the heartwarming story of a new apprentice named Yuzu, and the other fox girls who work at a hot spring hotel called Konohatei. The staff at Konohatei live by one belief: no matter who one may truly be, no matter what, anyone who is a guest is a god. Of course, that includes you. Let the hospitality of Yuzu and the Konohatei heal your tired soul.

seasons.title: Saki Episode of Side A
seasons.description: Nodoka's arrival sparks joy in Achiga's mahjong club, but upcoming changes threaten their unity.

Despite this, she has been in love with the schools most handsome, and most intelligent guy, Irie Naoki ever since she saw him give a speech at the high school entrance ceremony.

seasons.description: Hayato Kisaragi is kind of a big deal at his brand-new school, Little Garden academy. With the highest Hundred compatibility, he has what it takes to control the only effective weapon against the devastating creatures known as the Savage. But while he’s trying to master his ability, he’ll have to survive the onslaught of attention from the girls of this student body!

seasons.title: Please tell me! Galko-chan
seasons.description: Galko, Otako and Ojou are a trio of unlikely friends in high school with three very different perspectives. Each episode embarks on a day in the life of a trendy girl, an otaku, and a lady, as they discuss their “girl problems.”

seasons.title: Cerberus
seasons.description: Sword and magic rule in the continent of Kunaan, where the feared "Evil Dragon" Dagan Zot, a destructive and unstoppable force, resides. Hiiro's parents joined other sorcerers in a magic ritual ten years ago in an attempt to seal the dragon, but failed when someone interfered. After being rescued by Giruu, young Hiiro set out to learn swordsmanship so that he could avenge his parents.

seasons.title: Ooya-san wa Shishunki!
seasons.description: Ooya-san wa Shishunki! follows the antics of Chie Satonaka, a middle schooler who is a landlord. Though she appears a little girl, at times, she behaves more like a grandmother, doing all the cleaning, cooking and housework around the apartment. Despite her responsibilities, she still enjoys a normal middle school life with her friends.

seasons.title: Seven Mortal Sins
seasons.description: Before Lucifer’s fall, Hell was ruled by seven demon lords, known as the Seven Mortal Sins. These beautiful and tempting devils seek complete corruption of the world, but everything is about to change when Lucifer is cast down to their realm of Hell, and takes up arms with an Earth girl named Maria. Whose corruption will rule Hell and the hearts of mankind?

seasons.title: Last Exile
seasons.description: Claus Valca and his fiery navigator Lavie are obsessed with becoming the first sky couriers to cross the Grand Stream in a vanship. But when the high-flying duo encounters a mysterious girl named Alvis, they are thrust into the middle of an endless battle between Anatoray and Disith—two countries systematically destroying each other according to the code of chivalric warfare.

seasons.description: Howan enjoys a peaceful life in the countryside, but in secret, she dreams of taking the stage and enjoying music stardom. Fate smiles on her one day when she passes an audition and heads to Midi City for the all-star battle of the bands. There she meets Himeko Mashima, an equally passionate guitarist looking to belong. Together, they’ll soar to new heights among the stars and bright lights.

seasons.title: Show By Rock!! Stars!!
