Just as it appears the rebellion will be crushed, a hero arrives to join the fight. Pirate Cleo Corbeille—the last of the fallen Royal Family—steers his sleek battleship into battle and brings new hope that freedom can be obtained.

seasons.title: ORESUKI Are you the only one who loves me?
seasons.description: Kisaragi Amatsuyu is invited out by the beautiful Cosmos from his school. He expects to hear a confession: that she likes him. But, to his shock and horror, she likes his friend instead! Not all is lost, as a girl in the shadows takes a liking to Amatsuyu.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Following his brave deeds in the Russo-Japanese war, veteran Sugimoto hardly bats an eye at the harsh wilderness of Hokkaido. But when he stumbles across part of a treasure map, things get deadly. The map is divided among several escaped convicts, and this battle-hardened soldier isn’t the only one who knows it.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: Sugimoto, Asirpa, and Shiraishi gain some surprising allies on their way to Abashiri Prison. There’s just one problem. A traitor is in their midst! With enemies attacking from every direction, all roads lead to the man behind an Ainu massacre, and only Asirpa will know if he’s her father.

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: Saichi “The Immortal” Sugimoto visits the fortune teller Inkarmat to help him find Asirpa. He is joined by Tanigaki Genjiro, Cikapasi, and Koito Otonoshin and Tsukishima Hajime of the 7th Division. They travel to Karafuto in the north of Japan and must face the cold, Russians, and a wolverine. Only Asirpa can solve the mystery surrounding the gold, but will Sugimoto find her in time?

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.description: Sugimoto and Asirpa reunite at last! Partners once again with new key information, they’re one step closer to treasure, but they’re not the only ones in this race. Together they’ll continue their trek north facing menacing terrain with the 7th Division right behind. Will they find the gold and survive to reap the rewards?

seasons.title: Golden Kamuy OADs
seasons.description: Following his brave deeds in the Russo-Japanese war, veteran Sugimoto hardly bats an eye at the harsh wilderness of Hokkaido. But when he stumbles across part of a treasure map, things get deadly. The map is divided among several escaped convicts, and this battle-hardened soldier isn’t the only one who knows it.

seasons.title: Final Season
seasons.description: Returning from Karafuto, Sugimoto, Asirpa, and Shiraishi team up with escaped prisoner Oosawa Fusataro and speed toward Sapporo in search of Ueji Keiji. Lieutenant Tsurumi closes in on Asirpa and the tattooed convicts, unleashing his men to investigate a string of murders that Hijikata is already pursuing. As all three factions collide, the northern struggle hurtles toward its climactic showdown!

seasons.title: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
seasons.description: It is time for the Gundam Fight tournament! Each country sends a Gundam to Earth for this prestigious tournament in the hopes of winning power and glory for their homeland! But this time, there's an unseen evil lurking behind the scene. Domon Kasshu, Neo Japan's reluctant Fighter, is determined to uncover this evil and clear his family name! The fight to the top begins now!

seasons.title: King's Game
seasons.description: One night, all 32 members of a high school class receive a text message on their cell phone. It welcomes them to a game where they are given specific tasks to carry out in a 24-hour period. The tasks seem simple at first, but soon the tasks go beyond what the kids are comfortable with. Furthermore, they learn that the cost of failure is death. Will they be able to find a way out before more die?

seasons.title: Total Eclipse
seasons.description: Humanity's last stand against alien invaders, the BETA, hinges on piloted mechs in a desperate war.

seasons.title: Darling in the FRANXX
seasons.description: In a desolate future, children are kept away from the outside world, away from the open sky. Locked away in Mistilteinn, aka the ‘birdcage’, they live only to pilot giant mechs known as FranXX. Hiro was once a prodigy but after falling behind, he’s become unnecessary. After all, not piloting a FranXX is the same as not existing. But everything changes when he meets Zero Two, the girl with horns.

seasons.title: Tiger Mask W
seasons.description: Two young wrestlers, Naoto and Takuma, face off as Tiger Mask and Tiger the Dark, battling for justice.

seasons.title: Gun x Sword
seasons.description: There’s a claw-fisted, genocidal maniac terrorizing the planet of endless illusion, and only Van, a tight-lipped loner in a jet black tuxedo, can bring the scoundrel to justice. Armed with his shape-shifting sword and a mechanized suit of armor, Van hunts the villain who murdered his one true love. With any luck, he’ll find the man he seeks before the sun sets on civilization.

seasons.title: Kill la Kill
seasons.description: Ryuko Matoi’s search for the “woman with the Scissor Blade” leads her to Honnouji Academy, where students have superhuman powers given by special Goku uniforms. Ruling with unquestioned power is student body president Satsuki Kiryuin, who holds the secret to the Scissor Blade. Ryuko confronts Satsuki, but is their encounter coincidence or fate? Their clash will soon consume the whole academy!

seasons.title: HAIKYU!!
seasons.description: Haikyu!! is a slice-of-life volleyball sports anime based on the Weekly Shonen Jump manga series from Haruichi Furudate. Hinata is inspired to create a volleyball team in his last year of middle school. Matched against the "King of the Court" Tobio Kageyama's team they ultimately lose. Vowing to surpass Kageyama, Hinata joins the high school volleyball team only to find that Tobio has joined too.

seasons.title: HAIKYU!! 2nd Season
seasons.description: Hinata and Kageyama, former rivals, unite on the same high school volleyball team, aiming for the top.

seasons.title: HAIKYU!! 3rd Season
seasons.description: After their triumph in the Miyagi Prefecture Tournament, Karasuno High landed a spot in the finals. Now they’re up against Shiratorizawa Academy, the ultimate champions armed with ace spiker Wakatoshi Ushijima. This grueling five-set match will determine who advances to Tokyo. The fierce battle to qualify for nationals begins now!

seasons.title: HAIKYU!! TO THE TOP
seasons.description: The boys made it to nationals! While preparing for the tournament, Kageyama gets invited to the elite All-Japan Youth Training Camp. Shortly after, Tsukishima receives an invitation to the Miyagi Prefecture first-year selection training camp. Meanwhile, feeling left out, a frantic Hinata crashes the Miyagi first-year camp.

seasons.title: HAIKYU!! OVAs
seasons.description: Haikyu!! is a slice-of-life volleyball sports anime based on the Weekly Shonen Jump manga series from Haruichi Furudate. Hinata is inspired to create a volleyball team in his last year of middle school. Matched against the "King of the Court" Tobio Kageyama's team they ultimately lose. Vowing to surpass Kageyama, Hinata joins the high school volleyball team only to find that Tobio has joined too.

seasons.title: Haikyu!! The Dumpster Battle
seasons.description: Shoyo Hinata joins Karasuno High’s volleyball club to be like his idol, the “Little Giant.” But he finds he must team up with his middle school nemesis, Tobio Kageyama. Their clashing styles turn into a surprising weapon, but can they beat their rival Nekoma High in the highly anticipated Dumpster Battle?

seasons.title: Onara Goro
seasons.description: Fart man Onara Goro comes like the wind, letting rip all kinds of problems in this heartful comedy.

seasons.title: Rosario + Vampire
seasons.description: Tsukune’s horrible grades are making it tough for him to get accepted into any of the private schools he wants to attend. When one finally lets him enroll, his life takes an unusually strange twist: all of the other students are hiding supernatural secrets beneath their human disguises! It’s all too much for him—until he meets Moka, a gorgeous girl who is actually a vampire!

seasons.title: Rosario + Vampire Capu2
seasons.description: Tsukune, Moka and the gang return to Yokai Academy—where the supernatural student body rules the school! Keeping up with a bunch of hot demon girls has its perks, but if Moka’s bratty little sister has her way, Tsukune can kiss Moka’s sweet side goodbye. Family values get redefined when a MILF fight breaks out on campus, too. Forget about home ec—these ghouls gone wild always cook up trouble!

seasons.title: Chain Chronicle – The Light of Haecceitas –: Season 1
Danchigai
seasons.description: Based on a four-panel manga by Kazusa Yoneda, Danchigai focuses on the life of Haruki Nakano and his four sisters, all of whom live together in the same apartment complex. The only boy of five siblings, Haruki lives with his older sister Mutsuki, difficult younger sister Yayoi, and mischievous twins Uzuki and Satsuki.

seasons.title: Million Doll
seasons.description: Suko's blog turns unknown idols into stars. Her new mission: propel Fukuoka's Iotrio to fame.

seasons.title: Katana Maidens ~ Toji No Miko
seasons.description: A humanoid aradama joins the squad, but can she trust the Tojis who are sworn to exorcise her kind?

seasons.title: The Reflection
seasons.description: From legendary comic creator Stan Lee comes a brand-new superhero series! It happened suddenly—a worldwide phenomenon that took numerous lives and forever changed those that survived. The Reflection reformed the world and gifted many with power. Some use it for good, others for evil. But why did this happen and what does it mean for the future of the world? The shocking answer awaits you!

seasons.title: Locodol
seasons.description: By her uncle’s request, Nanako is an ordinary high school girl who teams up with her upperclassman Yukari to become their town’s local idols. The two get paid by the town to do interviews at malls, appear on local TV broad casts and hold small live events on department store rooftops. Together, the two form the "locodol" group Nagarekawa Girls.

seasons.title: Taboo Tattoo
seasons.description: A tattoo is an ancient weapon that enhances the physical ability of its user. When Justice Akatsuka accepts a stone as a token of gratitude, a mysterious tattoo appears on his palm. And so the battle begins, framed by a web of conspiracies and centering around the boy who obtained a tattoo by complete chance.

seasons.title: Squishy! Black Clover
seasons.description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, who is the only person who can't use magic, and the magical genius Yuno go all out to become the Wizard King. This is a spin off of the anime series "Black Clover" with an unbelievable story and an amazing cast.

seasons.title: Gundam - Reconguista in G
seasons.description: The Universal Century, an era of historic migration into space and space wars has ended, and some time has passed. Bellri Zenam is a cadet in the Capital Guard, the protectors of the tower. During a training exercise pirates attack the tower and Bellri crosses paths with the G-Self, a mobile suit with unknown technology...

seasons.title: Gundam Build Divers
seasons.description: A new game is sweeping cyberspace! Known as Gunpla Battle Nexus Online, or GBN, players dive into a vast world and use Gunpla models to complete special missions. Joining the game are middle school students Riku, Yukio, and Momoka, a promising bunch who don’t just build Gunpla—they build amazing adventures! What will happen when they come across a mysterious girl in the game?

seasons.title: Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE
seasons.description: Riku and friends dive into Gunpla Battle Nexus Online, building adventures with a mysterious girl, Sarah.

seasons.title: MIX MEISEI STORY Season 2
seasons.description: Meisei High School is all abuzz. They're determined to win this year, and a strong crop of new students is arriving! But it seems that's not all that's arriving... With summer of their second year approaching, new drama is about to arise in Touma and Souichirou's lives.

seasons.title: Xuan Yuan Sword Luminary
seasons.description: A rebel girl wields the legendary Xuan Yuan Sword, rising against the Taibai Empire's ancient power.

seasons.title: Time of Eve
seasons.description: "Time of EVE" is the latest work by Yasuhiro YOSHIURA, director of "Pale Cocoon" & "Aquatic Language". The series, produced by Studio Rikka & DIRECTIONS, Inc. released in 2008-2009. A 2013 Kickstarter to fund the global release of “Time of EVE: The Movie” received worldwide support. The Blu-ray features an English dub by Michael Sinterniklaas/NYAV Post & the OST. It also led to the English...
seasons.availability_notes: Episodes 2-6 are now only available to [link url="/freetrial?src=timeofeve"]Premium Members[/link] but we would like to thank all non-premium users who have supported this show.

seasons.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V (Original Japanese Version)
seasons.description: Yuya Sakaki discovers Pendulum Summoning, igniting fierce rivalries in a high-stakes dueling world.

seasons.title: Akashic Records of Bastard Magic Instructor
seasons.description: The new teacher at a magical academy has a rather unorthodox approach to education. Even though his students are driven to learn, he prefers to write instructions on the chalkboard then nap during class. His evident laziness and overall incompetence frustrate his students. However, when a terrible incident threatens the school, he shows a new side to himself that takes everyone by surprise.

seasons.title: Otome Yokai Zakuro
seasons.description: Westernization: a time when humans and spirits coexist. The Modernization of Japan has begun, and the Ministry of Spirit Affairs is established to resolve otherworldly incidents. Zakuro, Susukihotaru, Bonbori, and Hozuki are all half-spirits, partnered with second lieutenants, and they’re assigned to carry out any tasks given to them!

seasons.title: Minami Kamakura High School Girls Cycling Club
seasons.description: A new school, new friends, and a passion for cycling. Maiharu's high school adventures begin on two wheels.

seasons.title: FLIP FLAPPERS
seasons.description: Cocona is a model honor student, cautious and slow to embrace new opportunities. This makes life complicated when a mysterious girl named Papika suddenly appears, fearlessly searching for a wish-granting crystal called the "Shard of Mimi." When fates collide and they're given the ability to transform into powerful fairy-like beings, where will the dangerous journey into "Pure Illusion" take them?

seasons.title: ISUCA
seasons.description: Shinichiro seeks a job, meets Sakuya, an exorcist, and must help recapture a creature he freed.

seasons.title: Ace Attorney
seasons.description: Adapted from the popular video game franchise, Ace Attorney follows rookie lawyer Naruhodo Ryuuichi (Phoenix Wright) and his assistant Mayoi (Maya) as he defends his clients in a court of law. With limited evidence and logic as his only weapon, can Naruhodo turn the case around when all the odds are stacked against him?

seasons.title: Ace Attorney
seasons.description: Adapted from the popular video game franchise, Ace Attorney follows rookie lawyer Naruhodo Ryuuichi (Phoenix Wright) and his assistant Mayoi (Maya) as he defends his clients in a court of law. With limited evidence and logic as his only weapon, can Naruhodo turn the case around when all the odds are stacked against him?

seasons.title: KONOSUBA -God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
seasons.description: After a traffic accident, Kazuma Satou’s brief life was supposed to end, but he wakes up to a beautiful girl. She’s a goddess and asks if he’d like to go to a new world and bring one thing with him. He chooses her, and both are sent to a fantasy realm ruled by a Devil King. While Kazuma seeks peace, Aqua wants to solve the world’s problems, but the Devil King won’t turn a blind eye for long.

seasons.title: KONOSUBA -God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
seasons.description: After blowing up a nobleman’s mansion, Kazuma finds himself under arrest with a mountain of debt. He needs money and is short on options! Once more, Kazuma calls on his party to explore dungeons, find treasure, and face fantastical creatures to repay the debt. As they encounter new challenges and horrors, will their friendship survive? Or will vanity and quarreling prevail? Join them and see!

seasons.title: KONOSUBA -God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! 3
seasons.description: The dysfunctional party is back, but they may be short a member soon ’cause Kazuma is over it. Disillusioned with adventure, he wants to become a monk, but Aqua, Megumin, and Darkness call bull. However, the career dispute gets put on hold when a princess requests to hear all about their tales. Will the taste of fame at the royal castle keep them together or will this mark their farewell tour?

seasons.title: JK-MESHI!
seasons.description: In Japanese, “JK” is an abbreviation for “joshi kousei”, or high school girl, and “meshi” means “cooked rice” or “meal”, so it is only suitable that the anime focuses on 3 high school girls, Reina, Ryoka, and Ruriko, who have mastered the art of cooking simple, B-class dishes called JK meshi.

seasons.title: Inferno Cop
seasons.description: Inferno Cop vs. THE WORLD. The unholy officer's flame of justice burns!

seasons.title: Extras
seasons.description: Inferno Cop vs. THE WORLD. The unholy officer's flame of justice burns!
Not available in the US

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Satsuki Kakeru lived an ordinary life, until one day he and his childhood friend Minase Yuka were transported to a different world—one where an enormous, fiery black moon pulses in a blood-red sky. Now pursued by bizarre monsters, Kakeru and Yuka must learn to fight to survive in the world of Red Night…or perish.

seasons.title: PES: Peace Eco Smile
seasons.description: It takes place in Kichijoji, one of the most popular cities in Japan. Pes saves Kurumi when she almost falls into the pond of Iinokashira Park. Pes falls in love with Kurumi as soon as she kisses him. Pes starts working as a part-time in the flower shop and begins his adventures on Earth.

seasons.title: Grand Blues!
seasons.description: Join the colorful crew as they soar through grand blue skies, facing darkness and discovering new strengths.

seasons.title: Shadowverse Flame
seasons.description: At Shadowverse Battle College, they train students to be professional Shadowverse players. When novice player Light Tenryu transfers in, he quickly realizes his chosen club, Seventh Flame, may already have the cards stacked against them—they need three more members to compete. After that, they must face off against players like the fearsome Haruma Hazeura, First Reaper’s leader. All in, Light?

seasons.title: Digimon Adventure
seasons.description: Seven kids at summer camp are mysteriously transported to another reality, where they are befriended by a group of strange creatures who call themselves "Digimon," Digital Monsters.

seasons.title: Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu
seasons.description: Hitori Bocchi battles extreme social anxiety to fulfill a promise: befriend her entire class by graduation.

seasons.title: Dr. STONE
seasons.description: Modern society is lost when a mysterious light turns humanity to stone. Thousands of years pass and high schoolers Senku and Taiju awaken in an overgrown version of the world they once knew. With Senku as the brains and Taiju as the brawn, they’re determined to revive the petrified masses and rebuild civilization—but of those they’ve rescued, Tsukasa will rock their plans.

seasons.title: Dr. STONE Season 2
seasons.description: Armed with the power of science and a genius intellect, Senku is determined to save humanity. However, Tsukasa's empire goes on the offensive to halt the progress of science. Bolder choices are made as these two start a war that rocks the Stone World.

seasons.title: Dr. STONE Special Episode - RYUSUI
seasons.description: After defeating Tsukasa’s empire, the Kingdom of Science sets its sights on crossing the ocean to uncover the source of humanity’s petrification. To captain their journey, they revive Ryusui Nanami, a brilliant but greedy sailor who’s thrilled by the chance to claim everything in this new world. Before commanding the vessel through restless seas, they must first secure the king of fuels: oil.

seasons.title: Dr. STONE Season 3
seasons.description: The Kingdom of Science is on a journey of discovery! As Senku and friends set sail with his latest inventions, a dangerous new threat awaits in the distance. Can they keep course for the treasure island, or will they sink to the bottom of the stone world?

seasons.title: Dr. STONE SCIENCE FUTURE
seasons.description: After the battle on Treasure Island, Senku and the gang return to the Kingdom of Science. With their sights set on the Moon, they must first voyage to the Americas in hopes of beginning to harvest the required materials. Through teamwork and science, they continue the fight to save humanity once and for all!

seasons.title: Extras
seasons.description: Modern society is lost when a mysterious light turns humanity to stone. Thousands of years pass and high schoolers Senku and Taiju awaken in an overgrown version of the world they once knew. With Senku as the brains and Taiju as the brawn, they’re determined to revive the petrified masses and rebuild civilization—but of those they’ve rescued, Tsukasa will rock their plans.

seasons.title: Strike Witches: Road to Berlin
seasons.description: In 1944, the world lives in fear of unidentified flying objects that even the military can’t thwart! Humanity turns its desperate eyes to the girls of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing, better known as the Strike Witches. These dolls blast aliens to bits in the bat of an eyelash, and with a little magic and a whole lot of leg, the girls of the 501st are winning the war on pants—and aliens!

seasons.title: You Don't Know Gunma Yet
seasons.description: Kamitsuki moves to Gunma, a mysterious and terrifying place. What secrets will he uncover?

seasons.title: Merc StoriA: The Apathetic Boy and the Girl in a Bottle
seasons.description: In this world, healers are tasked with keeping the peace between humans and monsters. One such healer is a young boy, Yuu, who was gifted a mysterious bottle by his father. But upon touching the bottle, he awakens a strange girl named Merc who is trapped inside. Sadly, she has no memory of her life before meeting Yuu. So, the two embark on a magical journey to discover who she really is.

seasons.title: HIMOTE HOUSE: A share house of super psychic girls
seasons.description: Five girls and a cat share a house, each with a unique psychic power, seeking love amidst chaos.

seasons.title: Girly Air Force
seasons.description: Narutani Kei meets Gripen, a powerful Anima, as humanity battles mysterious flying creatures called Zai.

seasons.description: Chihaya dreams of becoming Japan's best karuta player, hoping to reunite with her friends through the game.

seasons.description: In futuristic Tokyo, Unit 8 battles crime with high-tech armor, struggling to gain respect in a rebuilt city.

seasons.title: Tenchi Muyo! War on Geminar
seasons.description: Young Kenshi Masaki was taken from his home planet, transported to a distant galaxy, and captured by a gorgeous princess! This royal beauty claims Kenshi as her personal servant—and lends him out to all the lecherous ladies at her prestigious boarding school. When Kenshi doesn’t have his hands full with a curvaceous coed, he can be found training for a looming intergalactic mecha battle.

seasons.title: Chitose Get You!
seasons.description: Chitose's enthusiasm causes chaos as she pursues her brother, turning school life into a hilarious adventure.

seasons.title: Chrono Crusade
seasons.description: In New York, 1928, the seals between Earth and Hell are breached. Brandishing sacred weaponry, elite exorcists Sister Rosette and Chrono—a devil whose incredible powers sap his partner’s life—clean the streets of demonic filth. In a race against time, this dynamite pair charges towards certain death to stop the apocalyptic horrors of the indomitable devil, Aion.

seasons.title: D4DJ Double Mix
seasons.description: Rika's bold proposal brings RONDO and Merm4id together, but Tsubaki's fears threaten to derail their plans.

seasons.title: D4DJ All Mix
seasons.description: Lyrical Lily must keep performances fresh for a year-long event, enlisting popular DJ units for a new stage.

seasons.title: Boogiepop and Others
seasons.description: Boogiepop, the angel of death, is back! Rumors fly as victims vanish in the night, but no one knows where they go. The mysterious specter is only a myth—at least, that’s what people think.

seasons.title: Blend-S
seasons.description: Tsundere, Idol, Oneesan, and Imouto (little sister type) are some of the personas that the waitresses play at Café Stile. New hire Maika is asked by the store manager to play none other than the Super Sadist! As she becomes devoted to her work, her sadist persona blooms unexpectedly. Everything is a treat—even being stomped on—in this outrageous working comedy.

seasons.title: HEROBANK
seasons.description: Kaito Gosho is an elementary school boy has amassed a 10 billion yen debt! The only way he can pay it off is to master “Hero Gi” and win matches in a futuristic cyber sport called “Hero battle.”

seasons.title: Love, Chunibyo, and Other Delusions: Season 2: Heart Throb (German Dub)
Love, Chunibyo, and Other Delusions: Season 2: Heart Throb
KanColle - Kantai Collection
seasons.description: Fubuki is a Special Type Destroyer who has just been assigned to the Naval District. With a grand total of zero battles under her belt, she’s sure to sink fast under the pressure of expectation. Luckily, she’s grouped with Torpedo Squadron Three, and they’re ready to support their new comrade. Together, they’ll prove they have what it takes to defend the ocean and win it all for humanity!

seasons.title: KanColle: See You Again on Another Quiet Blue Sea
seasons.description: Set in a world where humanity has lost control of the oceans to the "deep sea fleet," the only hope to counter this threat are the Kanmusu, a group of girls who possess the spirit of Japanese warships. The story revolves around Fubuki, a destroyer who comes to the Chinjufu base to train with other Kanmusu. Watch as their stories unfold!

seasons.title: Record of Grancrest War
seasons.description: Siluca and Theo join forces to restore peace in a land ruled by chaos, where lords fight for power.

seasons.title: Himegoto
seasons.description: The story follows Hime Arikawa, whose absent parents have left with saddled with a huge debt. After being saved from debt collectors by three girls on the student council, in exchange for paying off his debt, he agrees to spend the rest of his high school career dressed as a girl.

seasons.title: A Place Further Than the Universe
seasons.description: Four teenage girls are united in one mission: travel to Antarctica against all odds.

seasons.title: Idol Incidents
seasons.description: Japan's government can do nothing about the abundant problems and discontent throughout the land. Now, at long last, idols are taking a stand to rescue a nation with no way out!

seasons.title: Wakakozake Season 2 (Drama)
seasons.description: Wakako seeks solace in food and drink, exploring new places and savoring every bite.

seasons.title: Libra of Nil Admirari
seasons.description: A noblewoman gains powers to see emotions in cursed books, unraveling mysteries in Taisho-era Tokyo.

seasons.title: You and Me
seasons.description: "Friends since kindergarten and seemingly like blood brothers, You and Me follows the lives of Yuta and Yuki Asaba, Shun Matsuokan and Kaname Tsukahara; as well as transfer student Chizuru Tachibana who joins the circle of friends. Together we will watch as they laugh, dance, cry and share the memories of growing up together in everyday life.”

seasons.title: You and Me 2
seasons.description: Five friends navigate life's ups and downs, finding laughter, love, and surprises along the way.

seasons.title: DRAGON COLLECTION
seasons.description: Hiro finds himself in a world of gods and monsters, on a quest to become a legendary Dragon Master.

seasons.title: The World is Still Beautiful
seasons.description: Nike, a rain-calling princess, marries young King Livius, facing unexpected challenges and royal secrets.

seasons.title: When Supernatural Battles Became Commonplace
seasons.description: A group of five boys and girls suddenly acquire supernatural powers. Ready to fight in galactic battles to defend human cause… they are struck by the realization that there are no wars, no conspiracies, no evils empires, no nothing in their high school life. They instead decide to idly have fun by wasting their powers away.

seasons.title: Symphogear
seasons.description: With the coming of spring, Hibiki Tachibana and Miku Kohinata start their first year in high school school at the prestigious Lydian Music Academy. That their idol, the singer Tsubasa Kazanari, also attends Lydian is just an added bonus. Neither of them know that their lives are about to change forever. Neither of them know that the first, awakening beat is almost upon them.

seasons.title: Symphogear G (Season 2)
seasons.description: Hibiki and the Symphogear wielders face their toughest foe yet in dramatic, song-filled battles.

seasons.title: Symphogear GX (Season 3)
seasons.description: Hibiki and the Symphogear wielders face their toughest foe yet in dramatic, song-filled battles.

seasons.title: Alice & Zoroku
seasons.description: When trouble comes knocking, do you answer? What if that trouble is Sana, a little girl with the power to materialize anything she imagines? Old man Zoroku would prefer a quiet life, but even he can’t turn away when the escaped test subject ends up in his care. As the unlikely duo make do, their friendship takes root. But first, Sana must learn to use her powers responsibly.

seasons.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU: Season 2: TOO!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU: Season 3: Climax!
AIURA
seasons.description: They don't always see eye-to-eye, but that just makes these high school girls' daily lives more fun. "Their lives happen when nothing is happening" in this anime based on the lackadaisical four-panel manga. *This story features high school girls, but there's not much romance, and comedy has its place. Don't expect too much extravagance.

seasons.title: Sekko Boys
seasons.description: “Sekko Boys” is a four member boy band whose members are all idols, literally: the group leader Saint Giorgio, the original celebrity Medici, the multitalented Hermes and the lover Mars. However, the only catch is that they are all stone busts! The anime depicts their story of making it as a boy band with the support of their fresh-faced manager, Miki Ishimoto, who has only recently graduated...

seasons.title: Shonen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan
seasons.description: Ashibe and Goma's friendship blooms in a delightful, heartwarming season full of quirky adventures.

seasons.title: Tantei Team KZ Jiken Note: Season 1
A Centaur's Life
seasons.description: High school is a complicated time for any young centaur, but shy, sweet Himeno won’t have to clop through it alone! Surrounded by plenty of interesting classmates—satyrs, demons, angels, you name it—no matter what happens in her daily equestrian life, she’s got friends to help her through.

seasons.title: VOICE OF FOX
seasons.description: The ghost singer with the fox mask who can carry a tune and the idol who can't sing at all take on the world of entertainment together! Hu Li hides his face and ghost sings with his amazing voice. Kong Que is good looking, but can't sing to save his life. The two of them will butt heads with each other, and their rivals, as they climb the stairway to stardom.

seasons.title: Strike Witches: 501st JOINT FIGHTER WING Take Off!
seasons.description: Strike Witches, the 501st Joint Fighter Wing girls, are back from battle and ready to relax as best they can! War with the deadly Neuroi won’t last forever, but one thing is certain, the war on laundry is eternal. Join these aerial combat cuties in a down-to-earth series highlighting the team’s hijinks between missions.

seasons.title: World Witches Take Off!
seasons.description: Strike Witches, the 501st Joint Fighter Wing girls, are back from battle and ready to relax as best they can! War with the deadly Neuroi won’t last forever, but one thing is certain, the war on laundry is eternal. Join these aerial combat cuties in a down-to-earth series highlighting the team’s hijinks between missions.

seasons.title: Myself; Yourself
seasons.description: Sana Hikada returns to his hometown after 5 years away living in Tokyo. Although there are some changes to the town, most has remained the same. He notices a girl in a shrine maiden outfit, Nanaka Yatsushiro, who is a old childhood friend whom he gave a bracelet to before he left which she still wears to this day.

seasons.title: elDLIVE
seasons.description: Middle school student Chuta Kokonose has been hearing a voice in his head ever since he can remember. When a strange person recruits him to the space police force, he learns that the source of the voice is a Monitalien, a symbiotic creature living inside his body! Now, Chuta must prove his mettle to the entire department by protecting the universe from otherworldly criminals.

seasons.title: Kaze No Stigma
seasons.description: Kazuma is a descendent of an ancient clan skilled in the magic of fire, but the gift seems to have skipped a generation. Defeated by his female cousin, Ayano, in a battle to become the clan’s successor, Kazuma is exiled with only the burn of failure to keep him company. But now he’s back, armed with a powerful new mojo that’s sure to fan the flames of the family rivalry.

seasons.title: Season 1: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
seasons.description:
Part 1 - Phantom Blood

In ancient Mexico, people of Aztec had prospered. They had historic and strange "Stone Mask". It was a miraculous mask which brings eternal life and the power of authentic ruler. But the mask suddenly disappeared.

A long time after that, in late 19th centuries when the thought and life of people were suddenly changing, Jonathan Joestar met with Dio Brando―. They spend time together through boyhood to youth, and the "Stone Mask" brings curious fate to them―.

Part 2 - Battle Tendency

It’s been 49 years from Jonathan’s death. Time has been passed and generations have been alternated. Speedwagon became an oil tycoon established a foundation. Straizo is now the successor of ripple users taking over from his old master Tonpetty. At that time, a mysterious mummy was found at ruins in Mexico by archaeological diggers who Speedwagon’s foundation sent. Beside the mummy, relief of the hateful Stone Mask has been carved…!

The relation between the Joestars and the Stone Mask has not ended yet…!

seasons.title: Season 3: Diamond is Unbreakable
seasons.description: It has been 11 years since the defeat of the Joestar's arch nemesis, Dio. In 1999, Jotaro Kujo went to Morioh in S City in M Prefecture, Japan, to find his grandfather, Joseph Joestar's secret child, Josuke Higashikata. However, Josuke had the same ability as Jotaro, the Stand. And as though Jotaro was summoning them, a new group of Stand Users start to make their moves. There's something in this town... Josuke rises up to save Morioh, his hometown that he grew up in.

seasons.title: My Wife is the Student Council President
seasons.description: A new student council president vows to lift campus romance bans, leading to unexpected complications at home.

seasons.title: My Wife is the Student Council President
seasons.description: A new student council president vows to lift campus romance bans, leading to unexpected complications at home.

seasons.title: My Wife is the Student Council President+!
seasons.description: A new student council president vows to lift campus romance bans, leading to unexpected complications at home.

seasons.title: My Wife is the Student Council President+!
seasons.description: A new student council president vows to lift campus romance bans, leading to unexpected complications at home.

seasons.title: Black Butler
seasons.description: Ciel Phantomhive was born into a life of luxury only to see his parents brutally murdered before his eyes. Abducted and tortured by the fiends who killed his mother and father, Ciel trades his soul for a chance at vengeance. He summons Sebastian, a demon butler from the pits of hell. Together, they’ll prowl the darkest alleys of London, hunting the mysterious villains who made Ciel an orphan.

seasons.title: Black Butler II
seasons.description: Fans of the deranged escapades of Sebastian and Ciel will be perversely delighted by a new season of demonic adventures. Claude exists only to serve his young master, Alois: a boy who no doubt carries a dark secret.

seasons.title: Black Butler: Book of Circus
seasons.description: Ciel and the demon butler Sebastian are summoned by the Queen to investigate multiple reports of missing children. When their underworld contacts reveal the disappearances increase when the mysterious Noah’s Ark Circus comes to town, the demonic duo must impress an enigmatic ringmaster in order to go undercover as performers—to Sebastian’s delight and Ciel’s disgust.

seasons.title: Black Butler -Public School Arc-
seasons.description: Amidst Britain’s elite, Weston College defies government oversight. So, when students vanish—including the son of Queen Victoria’s cousin—Her Majesty sends her Watchdog Ciel Phantomhive to investigate. With his loyal demon butler, Sebastian, Ciel must navigate treacherous school politics and infiltrate Weston’s model prefects, the P4, if he is to unravel the mysteries that shroud this institution.

seasons.title: Black Butler -Emerald Witch Arc-
seasons.description: At the Queen’s behest, the 13-year-old earl Ciel Phantomhive and his loyal demon butler, Sebastian Michaelis, leave the gritty underworld of nineteenth-century England and venture to the south of Germany to investigate a series of mysterious deaths. Legend has it, those who enter the Werewolves’ Forest are destined to be cursed, but Ciel and Sebastian press on to uncover the truth.

seasons.title: Hayate the Combat Butler!
seasons.description: Hayate is a super-unlucky 16 year-old-boy. By chance, he rescues Nagi, the well-dressed heiress to a mega-rich family from hoodlums, then he gets hired as a live-in butler.

seasons.title: Hayate the Combat Butler!
seasons.description: Hayate, an unlucky teen, rescues an heiress and becomes her butler, navigating wealth and chaos.

seasons.title: Hayate the Combat Butler! Can't Take My Eyes Off You
seasons.description: Kenjiro Hata, notable for creating Hayate the Combat Butler, also created the new series Hayate No Gotoku! Can’t Take My Eyes Off You. In this series, Hayate Ayasaki continues to work alongside Maria at the Nagi Sanzenin’s mansion. Nagi receives a call from “Area 51” inviting her to the universe but will she accept?

seasons.title: Hayate the Combat Butler! Cuties
seasons.description: Kenjiro Hata, notable for creating Hayate the Combat Butler, also created the new series Hayate the Combat Butler! Can’t Take My Eyes Off You. In this series, Hayate Ayasaki continues to work alongside Maria at the Nagi Sanzenin’s mansion. Nagi receives a call from “Area 51” inviting her to the universe but will she accept?

seasons.title: KAIJU GIRLS
seasons.description: Kaiju Girls emerge in a peaceful world, balancing monster powers with everyday life's joys and struggles.

seasons.title: KAIJU GIRLS SEASON 2

seasons.title: Mr. Osomatsu
seasons.description: Mr. Osomatsu is based off of the gag manga series Osomatsu-kun by Fujio Akatsuka, and ran from 1962 to 1969. The series features a set of sextuplets, the Matsuno brothers, with Osomatsu being the oldest brother and leader of the group.
seasons.availability_notes: Due to a decision by the anime's production committee, episode 1 is no longer available.

seasons.title: Mr. Osomatsu 2nd Season
seasons.description: The boys are back and lazier than ever! After the world-shattering success of their first season, and by popular demand from all sections of the galaxy, the now grown-up sexy-tuplets from the hit manga Osomatsu-kun figured, “Another season? Why the hell not?

seasons.title: Mr. Osomatsu 3rd Season
seasons.description: Mr. Osomatsu is based off of the gag manga series Osomatsu-kun by Fujio Akatsuka, and ran from 1962 to 1969. The series features a set of sextuplets, the Matsuno brothers, with Osomatsu being the oldest brother and leader of the group.

seasons.title: Mr. Osomatsu 4th Season
seasons.description: The sextuplets run amok for a fourth time! Now adults in their 20s, they are still unemployed, undertrained, and single…but there’s something lovable about Japan’s most famous sextuplets. As a new chaotic adventure begins, what’s next? New friends? New trouble? And perhaps a new side to the sextuplets? Let’s all laugh together with these brothers who are beyond any hope.

seasons.title: Mobile Suit GUNDAM Iron Blooded Orphans
seasons.description: A group of child soldiers—Mikazuki Augus, Orga Itsuka, and several others—are sent to protect a young aristocrat seeking to liberate a Martian city from Earth’s rule. When an outside force threatens those involved, Mikazuki must head into battle using a war-era relic—the Gundam Barbatos.

seasons.title: Mobile Suit GUNDAM Iron Blooded Orphans
seasons.description: The Earth Sphere had lost its previous governing structure, and a new world was created under new systems of government. While a temporary peace had arrived, the seeds of a new conflict were being sown in the Mars Sphere, far away from Earth.

seasons.title: In Another World With My Smartphone
seasons.description: When Touya Mochizuki is accidentally struck by lightning and killed, God apologizes by reviving him into a fantasy world and granting him one wish. Touya’s request? To keep his smartphone in the next world. In his second chance at life, Touya befriends many important figures, inherits the legacy of an ancient civilization, and travels around with incredible power and a harem of girls!

seasons.title: In Another World With My Smartphone Season 2
seasons.description: After mistakenly being killed by God, Touya is reborn into a fantasy world. He was able to keep his smartphone and has since learned that it has new powers, and so does he. Now that he’s inherited the legacy of an ancient civilization and joined forces with the kings of this carefree world, Touya is about to embark on new adventures with his harem of very unique girls.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: An office worker reborn as a noble's 8th son uses magic to escape solitude and societal shackles.

seasons.title: The Case Files of Jeweler Richard
seasons.description: Seigi saves Richard, uncovering secrets through jewelry. Their bond deepens as mysteries unfold.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Tokyo is burning, and citizens are mysteriously suffering from spontaneous human combustion throughout the city! Responsible for snuffing out this inferno is the Fire Force, and Shinra is ready to join their fight. Now, as part of Company 8, he’ll use his devil’s footprints to help keep the city from turning to ash! But his past and a burning secret behind the scenes could set everything ablaze.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: Shinra and Company 8 have figured out the Evangelist’s goal. After learning about his past, our hero is now more motivated to discover the truth about his mother and save Sho. But a mysterious girl reveals the Evangelist’s plan—another Great Cataclysm.

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: Shinra and the team are about to uncover the world’s greatest secret. But just as the other Special Fire Force Companies unite to face the looming disaster, Obi is captured by the Tokyo Imperial Army, and Company 8 is branded as traitors. Hunted by the Empire, they must fight alone to rescue Obi and stop the Evangelist—all while a new assassin and the corrupt Captain Burns block their path.

seasons.title: YU-NO: A Girl Who Chants Love at the Bound of This World
seasons.description: During the summer, Takuya Arima receives a package—from his missing father—detailing the existence of parallel universes. He investigates further and soon realizes that he’s been given the key to cross-dimensional time travel. Now, Takuya is forced to use this newfound tech to unravel the mystery of his father’s whereabouts and find out why those closest to him are keeping secrets.

seasons.title: SING "YESTERDAY" FOR ME
seasons.description: Four friends navigate love, misunderstandings, and entangled emotions in a small town, striving for happiness.

seasons.title: DENKI-GAI
seasons.description: In a quirky bookstore, manga fans navigate work, love, and laughs, blushing at every turn.

seasons.title: Battle Girls - Time Paradox
seasons.description: Modern-day middle school girl Hideyoshi is mysteriously hurled into a world resembling the warring states period of Japanese history, only this time it's inhabited only by women.

seasons.title: Donyatsu
seasons.description: Donyatsu is a cat-like, chocolate-coated donut creature living in an abandoned Shinjuku, Tokyo. Lots of strange fun with his yummy friends! Tastefully funny short stories with brand new characters not seen in the original!

seasons.title: Yotsuiro Biyori
seasons.description: At Rokuhoudou, the team excels in hospitality, helping customers with worries and creating heartwarming tales.

seasons.title: Space Battleship Tiramisu
seasons.description: The Earth Union is locked in a massive galactic war and the Space Battleship Tiramisu protects our planet from annihilation. Ace pilot Subaru Ichinose—socially awkward and plagued by an intense, almost sexual love for food—carries the fate of humanity on his shoulders. From the comfort of his warm, enveloping cockpit, Subaru will find out what it means to be alive in a truly unforgiving universe.

seasons.title: Space Battleship Tiramisu Zwei
seasons.description: The Durandal has harbored its last Subaru, but a stronger mech rises from its crumb-ridden ashes—the new and improved Neo Durandal. Plus this cockpit is way nicer than the last one (it even has reclining seats)! However, with war still raging between the Earth Union and the People of Metus, Subaru has even more battles to fight, relatives to bicker with, and social boundaries to cross.

seasons.title: ISLAND
seasons.description: The tides are turning on the island of Urashima, where a mysterious young man has washed ashore. Claiming to be from the future, he finds himself at the center of a dark history, when he meets the heirs of the island’s most prominent families. What destiny awaits him in the sands of time?

seasons.title: Music Girls
seasons.description: Eleven aspiring idols strive for stardom, despite challenges and debt, seeking a new member to ignite success.

seasons.title: Gravion
seasons.description: It’s 2041 A.D. and extraterrestrial robots are invading the solar system to extinguish all existing life. Amidst the chaos, Eiji goes looking for his missing sister…on an army base of the wealthy Klein Sandman, creator of a secret army and a gravity-powered robot named Gravion designed to fight back. Now Eiji has a dilemma: piloting Gravion to protect Earth may mean never seeing his sister again.

seasons.title: Gravion Zwei
seasons.description: Six teens unite to pilot GRAVION, Earth's last defense, learning friendship and teamwork in battle.

seasons.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai
seasons.description: Sakuta Azusagawa, a high school nobody, never expected to find a bunny girl in the library. What’s more, the girl he meets isn’t just anyone—she’s a former actress and popular upperclassman—or at least she was, until, somehow, she disappeared from everyone’s view. Now, Sakuta is the only one who can see her or even remember that she existed. Perhaps going unnoticed is just a symptom of puberty.

seasons.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl
seasons.description: Sakuta Azusagawa, a high school nobody, never expected to find a bunny girl in the library. What’s more, the girl he meets isn’t just anyone—she’s a former actress and popular upperclassman—or at least she was, until, somehow, she disappeared from everyone’s view. Now, Sakuta is the only one who can see her or even remember that she existed. Perhaps going unnoticed is just a symptom of puberty.

seasons.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out
seasons.description: As Sakuta’s days at Minegahara High School come to a close, his little sister, Kaede, discovers her dream to attend school with him. With newfound determination, she’ll embark on a journey of growth to overcome her overwhelming anxiety. Entrusting her dream with Sakuta and gaining his support, together they’ll take steps toward a new future.

seasons.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid
seasons.description: As Sakuta and his girlfriend, Mai, prepare for the end of their high school days together, a haunting encounter with a girl resembling Mai’s past brings unsettling questions. Meanwhile, a long-awaited reunion with Sakuta and his sister Kaede’s estranged mother leads to unexpected revelations and physical manifestations—the onset of puberty syndrome.

seasons.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus
seasons.description: Sakuta Azusagawa is now a university student enjoying a calm life with his girlfriend, Mai Sakurajima—until a mysterious girl in a miniskirt Santa outfit appears, calling herself Touko Kirishima and claiming she spreads Puberty Syndrome to others. As strange phenomena surround Sakuta and his loved ones, the mystery continues.

seasons.title: Urawa no Usagi-chan
seasons.description: Urawa no Usagi-chan is an original series centered around the daily lives of 8 girls in junior high school in Saitama prefecture's Urawa district. Usagi, Tokiwa, Minami, Sakura, Midori, Kojika, Saiko, Misono - Enjoy watching their unique personalities play off against each other as their fun-filled school life unfolds.

seasons.title: Happiness!
seasons.description: On the holiday just before the Valentines Day, Kohinata Yuma is called by his bad friend Watarase Jun to buy chocolate with her. Since that day, his fate begins to change.

seasons.title: Anne-Happy
seasons.description: A group of girls, each with their own unique misfortune, navigate high school with humor and cheer.

seasons.title: 07 Ghost
seasons.description: Teased unmercifully for his past as an orphan and a slave, Teito has only his best friend Mikage and his mastery of the magical art of Zaiphon to ease his days at the elite Barsburg Academy.

seasons.title: Steins;Gate 0
seasons.description: A divergent continuation of the original Steins;Gate ending, Steins;Gate 0 explores an alternate worldline where Okabe abandons time travel. Plagued by his memories, Okabe’s best efforts to maintain a semblance of normalcy lead him to attend academia. But while attempting to forget past traumas and get his life back on track, he meets an AI that re-opens old wounds.

seasons.title: Senyu
seasons.description: Long ago, there lived an evil being who reigned over the world through fear, called Satan Rchimedes. He invaded the human world with his many demon underlings, spreading madness and chaos everywhere. One thousand years ago, this menace was sealed by the hero Creation, and peace returned to the world.

seasons.title: Senyu (Part 2)
seasons.description: Long ago, there lived an evil being who reigned over the world through fear, called Satan Rchimedes. He invaded the human world with his many demon underlings, spreading madness and chaos everywhere. One thousand years ago, this menace was sealed by the hero Creation, and peace returned to the world.

seasons.title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED: Season 1
seasons.description: In Year 70 of the Cosmic Era, the tension between natural humans and the genetically engineered Coordinators explodes into a full-scale war. When his colony is attacked, student Kira Yamato—secretly a Coordinator himself—must fight his own people by piloting a prototype mobile weapon known as GUNDAM. There, he’ll face his greatest battle…against his childhood best friend, Athrun.

seasons.title: Black Cat
seasons.description: The bounty hunter Sven is barely scraping by when he crosses paths with the Black Cat (a.k.a. Train Heartnet) and the young bio-weapon Eve. The three new companions will need more than luck to survive when they find themselves sought by both the Chronos Numbers and a Taoist revolutionary group called the Apostles of the Star.

seasons.title: Puzzle & Dragons X
seasons.description: Ace is an average boy until he hears his name being called by a mysterious egg. The egg leads him to discover the existence of Dragon Callers, humans who tame friendly monsters into allies in their fight against evil. With an egg calling his name, it seems that Ace is destined to be a Dragon Caller, but the road to summoning dragons isn’t going to be easy.

seasons.title: Puzzle & Dragons X Season 2
seasons.description: From the studio Pierrot, that brought you Kingdom and Tokyo Ghoul comes a series based off of the hit game Puzzle & Dragons. Dorogoza Island is rich in "Drop Energy" that players can use on friendly monsters. Once strong enough, they can face enemies in puzzle wars. Winners reap rewards, but what happens to the losers? Only the brave can take on these monstrous challenges!

seasons.title: Nobunaga Concerto
seasons.description: Due to some unlikely events, Saburo is flung back in time to the Sengoku Era. In the past, he meets a young, but sickly Oda Nobunaga, one of Japan’s greatest war lords. Unable to shake Saburo’s uncanny resemblance to himself, Nobunaga asks Saburo to take his place as war lord. Equip with knowledge from the modern era, will Saburo be able to unite Japan?

seasons.title: Lord Marksman and Vanadis
seasons.description: Tigre, a young noble, is captured by a beautiful female general from an enemy country. Though enchanting, her curves aren’t the only dangerous thing about her. She’s backed by an army of desirable warrior-goddesses called the Vanadis. Can the valiant Tigre survive the action-packed blend of fantasy and fan service!?

seasons.title: Masamune-kun's Revenge
seasons.description: As a child, Masamune Makabe was mercilessly teased about his weight and cruelly nicknamed “Pig’s Foot” by a young girl named Aki Adagaki. Years later, Masamune continues to hold resentment and decides to seek revenge against his tormenter. Now, handsome and in top shape, he returns to exact vengeance on Aki! But as he gets closer to her, he finds his heart desires something other than revenge.
seasons.availability_notes: [link url="http://www.gomanga.com/books/masamune-kuns-revenge/736"]Read the original Masamune-kun's Revenge manga, available from Seven Seas Entertainment![/link]

seasons.title: Masamune-kun's Revenge R
seasons.description: Masamune and Aki are headed to Paris! During this class trip, they meet a French girl aspiring to become a manga artist. When she learns they’re from Japan, she begs them for advice on her manga, which happens to be a rom-com. The two agree and soon get in way over their heads. But in the midst of emotion, Aki reveals her true feelings for someone she once met eight years ago.

seasons.title: Wagamama High Spec
seasons.description: Kouki Narumi, a high school manga artist, joins the student council to keep his identity a secret.

seasons.title: Peacemaker
seasons.description: After the murder of his parents, young Tetsu begins a quest for vengeance that threatens to consume his soul. His journey leads him to the Shinsengumi, an order of swordsmen at war with the villains who cut down his parents. Tetsu’s training gives him the strength to seek revenge, but he must decide whether to yield to his demonic urges—or become a true peacemaker like his father before him.

seasons.title: Tegami Bachi Letter Bee
seasons.description: Gauche's final delivery holds a secret, as a young boy named Lag inspires him on their perilous journey.

seasons.title: Tegami Bachi Letter Bee
seasons.description: Gauche Suede is on his last delivery before a big promotion. In the outskirts of Yodaka, the darkest area of Amberground, Gauche is surprised to find that the package is a young boy named Lag Seeing. Lag had been traumatized by his mother's abduction and is due to be delivered to his aunt. In this remote area rife with Gaichuu, Lag and Gauche face a dangerous journey that inspires Lag to become...

seasons.title: Wooser's Hand-to-Mouth Life: Awakening Arc
seasons.description: Wooser, a lovable yet cunning creature, navigates life with humor and a hunger for meat, money, and girls.

seasons.title: Wooser’s Hand-to-Mouth Life: Phantasmagoric Arc
seasons.description: The zany and cute-but-crude Wooser returns for another season in Wooser’s Hand-to-Mouth Life: Phantasmagoric Arc! Voiced by the prolific and hugely popular voice actor Mamoru Miyano, Wooser is a creature that only cares about three things in life: meat, money, and girls.
seasons.availability_notes: Season 1 & 2 of Wooser's Hand-to-Mouth Life can be found at: [url]www.crunchyroll.com/wooser[/url]

seasons.title: Ace of the Diamond
seasons.description: Eijun Sawamura finally makes his first appearance at the spring invitational! He wants to restore Seido’s reputation as a first-rate team and make them national champions! Seido High School Baseball Club’s new run is about to begin!

seasons.title: Ace of the Diamond Second Season
seasons.description: Eijun Sawamura finally makes his first appearance at the spring invitational! He wants to restore Seido’s reputation as a first-rate team and make them national champions! Seido High School Baseball Club’s new run is about to begin!

seasons.title: Ace of the Diamond act II
seasons.description: Eijun Sawamura finally makes his first appearance at the spring invitational! He wants to restore Seido’s reputation as a first-rate team and make them national champions! Seido High School Baseball Club’s new run is about to begin!

seasons.title: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
seasons.description: Seido High’s star pitcher, Eijun Sawamura, has finally earned the prized ace uniform, but this summer is his last shot to lead the school’s baseball team to victory. He and his stoic teammates Furuya, who battles injury, and Miyuki, who anchors the team as captain, will hold the rope through every curve ball that comes their way in the tournament.

seasons.title: Princess Jellyfish
seasons.description: Tsukimi and her wallflower friends are hopeless nerds with bizarre hobbies. Their crippling social anxieties keep them from setting foot outside the all-girl apartment complex they inhabit, but a late night jellyfish rescue mission and the arrival of a “Stylish Girl” are about to turn their lives upside down!

seasons.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World
seasons.description: Seven high school geniuses, stranded in a magical world, use their wits to reshape society and upend tyranny.

seasons.title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
seasons.description: Dai, the lone human on a monster-filled island, battles to save the world from resurrected Dark Lord Hadlar.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Ordinary 37-year-old Satoru Mikami dies and is reincarnated as the most unremarkable creature imaginable—a slime. Initially, things are pretty grim. But by combining his special abilities with some good old-fashioned charisma, the newly named, Rimuru Tempest, will use his blobby powers to create a nation, destroy the malicious, and convince the world that maybe monsters aren’t so bad after all.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: As Demon Lord Rimuru expands his domain, his dream of a nation where humans and monsters can prosper together is almost realized. To celebrate and invite new citizens, a grand festival is thrown. However, his new realm faces a threat when a fabricated war declaration draws the monster-hating cult of Luminism toward it for battle. Can Rimuru save his dream or will it be destroyed before it begins?

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.description: Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

seasons.title: OVA Season 1
seasons.description: Ordinary 37-year-old Satoru Mikami dies and is reincarnated as the most unremarkable creature imaginable—a slime. Initially, things are pretty grim. But by combining his special abilities with some good old-fashioned charisma, the newly named, Rimuru Tempest, will use his blobby powers to create a nation, destroy the malicious, and convince the world that maybe monsters aren’t so bad after all.

seasons.title: OVA Season 2
seasons.description: Rimuru’s teaching days are behind him, but his journey continues as he disguises himself as “Satoru” and delves into a kingdom mired in power struggles, supernatural intrigue, and a race for the throne that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Will he master the art of royal survival while unraveling a web of supernatural conspiracies? There’s only one way to find out!

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Iwanaga Kotoko wields influence over the supernatural world, solving their problems with razor-sharp wit, and the occasional lie. Her real obsession? Sakuragawa Kuro, a man even spirits fear. As they investigate urban legends, their partnership walks the line between mystery and romance. But in this world of monsters, Iwanaga might be the most unpredictable force of all.

seasons.title: Mr Love: Queen's Choice
seasons.description: She inherits a company and meets four extraordinary men, uncovering secrets and a conspiracy tied to her past.

seasons.title: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord
seasons.description: Takuma Sakamoto is famously known as the Demon Lord throughout the MMORPG Cross Reverie. And although he’s a magical prodigy in the game, in reality, he’s a total social outcast. One day, in his video game body, he is summoned to another world by two girls seeking to own him. But when he accidentally reflects their enslavement spell back at them, the only way to save face is to act how he looks.

seasons.title: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord: Season 2
How Not to Summon a Demon Lord: Season 2 (German Dub)
Chaika -The Coffin Princess-
seasons.description: The year is 1604. On the continent of Verbist, an age of war lasting for three generations finally ended with the fall of the northern nation, the Gaz Empire. In addition to legitimate knights and soldiers, the militant forces sent to battle included wizards, saboteurs, and mercenaries, totaling 620,000. What's more, three airborne strongholds and massive numbers of magical weapons plus beast...

seasons.title: Chaika -The Coffin Princess- Avenging Battle
seasons.description: The year is 1604. On the continent of Verbist, an age of war lasting for three generations finally ended with the fall of the northern nation, the Gaz Empire. In addition to legitimate knights and soldiers, the militant forces sent to battle included wizards, saboteurs, and mercenaries, totaling 620,000. What's more, three airborne strongholds and massive numbers of magical weapons plus beast...

seasons.title: Romeo X Juliet
seasons.description: As Juliet prepares to raise her sword against the tyrant whose hands are stained by the blood of her ancestors, only Romeo stands in her way—the boy she loves and the son of the man she must kill. She is the last breath of a dying line of kings, and the final hope of a city that desperately needs her.

seasons.title: Fairy Musketeers
seasons.description: Join Little Red Riding Hood, Snow White and Briar Rose as they are appointed to be guardians of a sealed key.

seasons.title: Magical Destroyers
seasons.description: Freedom of expression is threatened when a mysterious group, the SSC, destroy Japan’s otaku culture. However, a young revolutionary, Otaku Hero—who loves the culture more than anything—rises up. With the help of three rambunctious magical girls—Anarchy, Blue, and Pink—they’ll team up to create a world free of this oppressive rule. Be part of the rebellion to bring back fandom!

seasons.title: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: U149 Season 01
Bartender
seasons.description: At the bar Eden Hall in Ginza, Ryu Sasakura creates cocktails dubbed 'The Glass of the Gods'.

seasons.title: TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy-
seasons.description: Makoto Misumi is an ordinary high school student until the day he’s summoned to a fantasy world to serve as its brave hero. His legend is cut short when the goddess casts him out to the edge of the world. The moon god, Tsukuyomi-no-Mikoto, saves Makoto and grants him great power and freedom. On his journeys, he befriends other outcasts and demi-gods as they carve a new path and create a new world.

seasons.title: TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- Season 2
seasons.description: After Makoto Misumi defeats Mitsurugi and Sofia Bulga, humanity is saved from the attacking demon army—for the time being. The goddess is aware of Makoto’s growing power, and she sees him as less of a nuisance and more of a rival. Makoto continues his journey to further expand his community of outcasts and connect with more of his kind. But will he be strong enough to hold off the coming storm?

seasons.title: CESTVS -The Roman Fighter-
seasons.description: Cestvs enters his inaugural match at the slave gladiator training school only to discover his first opponent is his best friend. He defeats his friend, winning the match. Filled with sorrow and rage, Cestvs fights powerful competitors, one after another. Standing in the shadow of Roman Emperor Nero, with no other way out, can Cestvs fight his way to freedom?

seasons.title: Captain Tsubasa 2018
seasons.description: For Tsubasa Ozora, soccer isn’t just a game. His goal is to defeat his rivals, win a national championship, and one day win the FIFA World Cup for Japan. Tsubasa and his mother move so he can attend Nankatsu Elementary School, known for its soccer excellence. Unlike his old school, he’ll need to train hard and hone his talents to stand out on his team and lead them to victory.

seasons.title: Bogus Skill <<Fruitmaster>> ~About that time I became able to eat unlimited numbers of Skill Fruits (that kill you)~
seasons.description: In a world where Skill Fruits grant powers, aspiring adventurer Light is stuck with the useless <<Fruitmaster>> skill. Eating another one results in death, so no do-overs. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Rena quickly rises to S Rank. But when Light accidentally eats a second Skill Fruit, he survives and discovers his true power: He can consume unlimited Skill Fruits and gain their abilities!

seasons.title: Fluffy Paradise
seasons.description: When this overworked office lady finally meets her maker, she’s reborn with an adorable ability. Midori is reincarnated in another world as a young girl, Nema, and must help decide if the humans there should continue to exist. In return, she gains the power to be loved by all nonhuman creatures. From fantasy beasts to mythical monsters, she’s free to pet any animal to her heart’s content!

seasons.title: KamiErabi GOD.app
seasons.description: The ultimate battle royale for divinity has begun. High schoolers must use their unique powers to compete against each other for the coveted title “God.” But as each brawl becomes more vicious than the last, alliances are formed and betrayals take place. Who will emerge victorious and claim their godly throne?

seasons.title: Season 02
seasons.description: Same school, new rivals. The students of Suezane Yuai Academy use their special powers in competition for the coveted title of “God.” After Goro succeeded in stopping Kyo and Ryo, he lost his powers. But in that moment, he remembered his true wish. The fierce battle royale continues as allies become enemies and friends become foes in the fight for the godly title and throne.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Six childhood friends make a vow one day to become treasure hunters, and eventually grow to be the strongest heroes in the world. During his first quest, Krai Andrey realizes he isn’t cut out for the job. Even so, his friends make him their leader. Underpowered in the face of great expectations, Krai embarks on a reluctant hero’s tale of glory, headaches, and wanting to retire early.

seasons.title: The Witch and the Beast
seasons.description: Guideau is a young woman who was cursed by a witch, forced to carry a dark secret. Ashaf is a tall, soft-spoken man with a coffin strapped to his back and secrets yet untold. Together they venture across the land on their quest for vengeance. Appearances can be deceiving, and each step could be their last. In a dark fantasy filled with adventure, will unlikely heroes find the vengeance they seek?

seasons.title: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero
seasons.description: Kaito is a high school student working as an ordinary explorer in the dungeons of Japan. He earns a modest living hunting slimes despite his low stats. During a typical trek underground, he finds a golden slime he’s never seen before. It drops a rare servant card that summons a legendary creature: a powerful valkyrie of otherworldly beauty!

seasons.title: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole  Season 01
The Vampire Dies in No Time
seasons.description: Legendary vampire hunter Ronaldo finds an unlikely (and unwilling) ally in Draluc, the world’s weakest vampire who turns to dust at the slightest attack. Together they’re in for more hilarious misadventures than you can shake a stake at, including enemy vampires, axe-wielding editors, and other pains in the neck.

seasons.title: The Vampire Dies in No Time Season 2
seasons.description: Legendary vampire hunter Ronaldo finds an unlikely (and unwilling) ally in Draluc, the world’s weakest vampire who turns to dust at the slightest attack. Together they’re in for more hilarious misadventures than you can shake a stake at, including enemy vampires, axe-wielding editors, and other pains in the neck.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: For cultivation prodigy Wang Ling, defeating a demon king at age 6 is nothing compared to fitting in at highschool. And now with supernatural threats on the rise, Wang may have to put his magic studies on hold to save the world!

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: For cultivation prodigy Wang Ling, defeating a demon king at age 6 is nothing compared to fitting in at highschool. And now with supernatural threats on the rise, Wang may have to put his magic studies on hold to save the world!

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: As demons are now refugees after the destruction of their home, the Kyuumiya family plots to drain their energy with the help of their first daughter—Yoshiko. Sent off to study at Faction 60 as her cover, she befriends Wang Ling and his crew, but it doesn’t take long before her true purpose is discovered. Will Wang Ling be able to stop the Kyuumiya before they achieve their goal?

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.description: Wang Ling can never catch a break! Somehow the Immortal Ling is now caught in the middle of a heated rivalry between two apprentices—Sword Saint and Sword Evil. Evil returns from martial arts training to find all his disciples dead. He seeks revenge, but, due to a misunderstanding, targets Wang Ling.

seasons.title: Season 5
seasons.description: Wang Ling’s family life is turned upside down with the arrival of a little sister, Wang Nuan. Immortal King Wang Ling vows to teach Wang Nuan to control her strength. In doing so, her strength catches the attention of Ye Kui, a sinister organization, and Bai Zhe, a high-level prisoner of the Mysterious Prison. Wang Ling decides to bring Wang Nuan along and teach these villains a lesson!

seasons.title: Shironeko Project ZERO Chronicle
seasons.description: In the wake of a monster attack, an elderly noble confronts the lone surviving boy. Impressed, he chooses the boy to become his heir to the Throne of Darkness. Meanwhile, in the iridescent clouds above, the Queen of Light and her army are at war with the monsters. But the new Prince of Darkness realizes that Light and Dark must unite and destroy the evil if the world is to survive.

seasons.title: SEVEN KNIGHTS REVOLUTION: Hero Successor
seasons.description: A forgotten hero awakens in Nemo, joining the Seven Knights to fight Destruction and save the world.

seasons.title: Blade Runner: Black Lotus
seasons.description: Los Angeles 2032. A young woman wakes up with no memories, and possessing deadly skills. The only clues to her mystery are a locked data device and a tattoo of a black lotus. Putting together the pieces, she must hunt down the people responsible for her brutal and bloody past to find the truth of her lost identity.

seasons.title: Fena: Pirate Princess
seasons.description: Fena, a former servant, discovers her pirate heritage and leads a crew on a thrilling high seas adventure.

seasons.title: Armor Shop for Ladies & Gentlemen
seasons.description: Kurtz and his armor shop crew, aided by a Demon King, find a mysterious armor piece falling from the sky.

seasons.description: Chizuru's search for her father leads her to the Shinsengumi, who battle inhuman foes amidst political chaos.
